Then.Name: DEBUG_MESSAGE_BOX
Arguments:
#!ra3luabridge
-- ============================================================

if _LOG == nil then
    function _LOG(msg)
        if type(exPrintln) == "function" then
            exPrintln("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
        end
    end
end

if _ALERT == nil then
    function _ALERT(msg)
        _LOG(msg)
        if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
            exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
        end
        if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
            exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
        end
    end
end

-- ★ 我方播报用独占名字，绝不抢通用全局名（全局 _ALERT 已被本图别的脚本占用且是哑的）
--   完整来龙去脉见 docs/03 §8「不要去抢通用全局名」；新代码一律用 ChoukaAlert / ChoukaAlertFor。

function ChoukaAlert(msg)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    -- ① 日志（唯一确认可靠的通道，必须第一个调）
    _LOG(msg)
    -- ② 左下消息区
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    -- ③ 公屏（全场可见，阵亡通报/占领播报靠它）
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
    end
end

-- 带显示时长的版本（公告类用长一点）
function ChoukaAlertFor(msg, seconds)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    _LOG(msg)
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        if seconds == nil then
            seconds = 10
        end
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, seconds)
    end
end

-- 真实昵称缓存：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 查到的玩家名（查一次就记住）
ChoukaPlayerNames = ChoukaPlayerNames or {}

-- ① 公屏 / 计分板 / 消息区用：真实昵称；拿不到就退回 $p<N>Name（这些通道会替换）
function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end


-- 节点自检表：哪个节点的 payload 真的跑起来过（只记一次）
ChoukaNodeReady = ChoukaNodeReady or {}

function ChoukaMarkNodeReady(nodeName)
    if ChoukaNodeReady[nodeName] == nil then
        ChoukaNodeReady[nodeName] = 1
        _LOG("节点就绪：" .. nodeName)
    end
end

-- 已经就绪的节点名，拼成一行字符串（给心跳日志用）
function ChoukaNodeReadyList()
    local list = ""
    for name, flag in ChoukaNodeReady do
        if list == "" then
            list = name
        else
            list = list .. "," .. name
        end
    end
    if list == "" then
        return "无"
    end
    return list
end

ChoukaChoiceHandlers   = ChoukaChoiceHandlers or {}
ChoukaLongTextHandlers = ChoukaLongTextHandlers or {}

function ChoukaAddChoiceHandler(f)
    if type(f) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaChoiceHandlers), 1 do
        if ChoukaChoiceHandlers[i] == f then
            return
        end
    end
    tinsert(ChoukaChoiceHandlers, f)
end

function ChoukaAddLongTextHandler(f)
    if type(f) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaLongTextHandlers), 1 do
        if ChoukaLongTextHandlers[i] == f then
            return
        end
    end
    tinsert(ChoukaLongTextHandlers, f)
end

function onUserBtnChoiceDialogEvent(playerName, btnIndex, dialogId)
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaChoiceHandlers), 1 do
        if ChoukaChoiceHandlers[i](playerName, btnIndex, dialogId) == 1 then
            return 1
        end
    end
    return 0
end

function onUserLongTextDialogEvent(playerName, btnIndex, dialogId)
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaLongTextHandlers), 1 do
        if ChoukaLongTextHandlers[i](playerName, btnIndex, dialogId) == 1 then
            return 1
        end
    end
    return 0
end

-- 详见 docs/10-Lua注释存档.md §03_start-4
function ChoukaStartRefreshHost()
    if ChoukaStartHostLocked == 1 and ChoukaStartHost ~= nil then
        return ChoukaStartHost
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(ObjectPlayerScriptName) == "function" then
        name = ObjectPlayerScriptName("<1st Human Player>")
    end
    if name ~= nil and name ~= "" then
        ChoukaStartHost = name
        ChoukaStartHostLocked = 1
    elseif ChoukaStartHost == nil then
        ChoukaStartHost = "Player_1"
    end
    return ChoukaStartHost
end

-- 相机：全体先钉到 center，再逐个玩家钉一次（DSA 两种都用过，双保险）
function ChoukaStartCameraToCenter()
    if type(ExecuteAction) == "function" then
        ExecuteAction("MOVE_CAMERA_TO", CHOUKA_START_CENTER_WP, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        for i = 1, 6, 1 do
            ExecuteAction("PLAYER_CAMERA_MOVE_TO", "Player_" .. i,
                CHOUKA_START_CENTER_WP, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        end
    end
    -- 兜底：动作不生效就直接改相机坐标（教程:195 / 206）
    if type(exCameraAdjustPos) == "function" then
        local p = exWaypointGetPos(CHOUKA_START_CENTER_WP)
        if p ~= nil and p[1] ~= nil then
            exCameraAdjustPos(p[1], p[2], p[3])
        end
    end
end

-- 相机锁：开局上锁，正式开始成对解锁（1 锁 / 0 解锁）
function ChoukaStartLockCamera(value)
    if type(ExecuteAction) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    ExecuteAction("LOCK_CAMERA", value)
    ExecuteAction("LOCK_CAMERA_SCROLL", value)
end

-- 地图中间那行提示：漂浮文字会自己消失，所以每次求值都重刷一遍
function ChoukaStartShowCenterText()
    if type(exShowTextAtPos) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    local p = exWaypointGetPos(CHOUKA_START_CENTER_WP)
    if p == nil or p[1] == nil then
        return                      -- 航点没了就别在原点刷字
    end
    local z = p[3]
    if z == nil then
        z = 0
    end
    exShowTextAtPos(CHOUKA_START_WAIT_TEXT, p[1], p[2], z + CHOUKA_START_TEXT_Z_OFFSET,
        CHOUKA_START_TEXT_COLOR)
end

-- 给单个玩家播一条左下角消息（API 不在就退回全体公屏）
function ChoukaStartTellPlayer(playerName, text, seconds)
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer(playerName, text, seconds)
    end
    _LOG(text)          -- 只写日志（开局节点在关键路径上，不冒险调未验证的可见通道），见 00_alert.lua
end

-- 全图播报一条：左下角消息区（实测能看到）+ 公屏（能否显示看 mod 版本）+ 日志
-- ⚠ 只在关键动作**之后**调用：可见通道万一报错，也挡不住开局的发钱/开门这些正事
function ChoukaStartBroadcast(text, seconds)
    if seconds == nil then
        seconds = 15
    end
    _LOG(text)
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea(text)
    end
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(text, seconds)
    end
end

-- 只给房主开的选择对话框（固定 10 个参数，照 16_buttons.lua 的 call 写法）
function ChoukaStartShowDialog(playerName, dialogId, title, choices)
    if type(exShowCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    local args = { playerName, dialogId, title }
    for i = 1, getn(choices), 1 do
        tinsert(args, choices[i])
    end
    while getn(args) < 10 do
        tinsert(args, "")
    end
    call(exShowCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer, args)
end

-- 两组选项拼成一条按钮列表：前面是箱子范围，后面是玩法，最后是确认 / 重看公告
-- 按钮总数上限 7（exShowCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer 固定 10 参 = 3 固定 + 7 按钮），
-- 现在是 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 个，还余 1 格
function ChoukaStartHostChoices()
    local choices = {}
    local k, opt, mark
    local scopeN = getn(ChoukaStartScopeOptions)
    local modeN = getn(ChoukaStartModeOptions)

    for k = 1, scopeN, 1 do
        opt = ChoukaStartScopeOptions[k]
        mark = ""
        if ChoukaStartScopeKey == k then
            mark = "√"                       -- 选中项带 √（作者指定的写法）
        end
        choices[k] = opt.name .. mark
    end

    for k = 1, modeN, 1 do
        opt = ChoukaStartModeOptions[k]
        mark = ""
        if ChoukaStartModeKey == k then
            mark = "√"
        end
        choices[scopeN + k] = opt.name .. mark
    end

    local confirmBtn = scopeN + modeN + 1
    local rereadBtn = scopeN + modeN + 2
    choices[confirmBtn] = "确认，开始游戏"
    choices[rereadBtn] = "重新查看公告"
    return choices, confirmBtn, rereadBtn
end

function ChoukaStartShowHostDialog(playerName)
    local choices = ChoukaStartHostChoices()
    ChoukaStartShowDialog(playerName, CHOUKA_START_HOST_DIALOG,
        ChoukaT.hostDialogTitle, choices)
end

-- ① 开局第一秒：锁视角 + 弹公告 + 挂中心提示
function ChoukaStartBegin()
    ChoukaStartStage = 1
    ChoukaStartTick = 0
    ChoukaStartRefreshHost()

    -- 视角锁在地图中间
    ChoukaStartCameraToCenter()
    ChoukaStartLockCamera(1)

    -- 固定玩家操作：先收掉右下角单位操作区（不碰鼠标键盘，房主还要点公告按钮）
    if type(exAptHideObjectDetailsArea) == "function" then
        exAptHideObjectDetailsArea()
    end
    if CHOUKA_START_LOCK_INPUT == 1 and type(ExecuteAction) == "function" then
        ExecuteAction("DISABLE_INPUT")
    end

    -- 全屏公告（长文本对话框：按钮传空串就隐藏，只留「已阅读」）
    if type(exShowLongTextDialog) == "function" then
        -- 按钮槽位：1=左 2=中 3=右；空串=不显示那个按钮。
        -- 只给第 1 个槽位按钮 → 实测靠左；放到中间槽位才是居中（照 DSA）
        exShowLongTextDialog(CHOUKA_START_ANNOUNCE_DIALOG, CHOUKA_START_ANNOUNCE_TEXT,
            "", ChoukaT.readDone, "")
    end

    -- 地图中间的等待提示 + 公屏
    ChoukaStartShowCenterText()
    _LOG(CHOUKA_START_WAIT_TEXT)
end

-- ② 等房主：每秒重钉视角、重刷提示，房主点确认就收尾
function ChoukaStartWaitTick()
    ChoukaStartTick = ChoukaStartTick + 1

    -- 房主可能第一秒还没认出来（玩家席位就绪有先后），等的时候每秒重认一次
    ChoukaStartRefreshHost()

    -- ⚠ 日冕的 Lua 是 4.0，**没有 % 运算符**（DSA 全程用 mod(x,y)），别手滑写成 %
    if mod(ChoukaStartTick, CHOUKA_START_CAMERA_PERIOD) == 0 then
        ChoukaStartCameraToCenter()
    end
    ChoukaStartShowCenterText()

    -- ⚠ 这里不再直接调 ChoukaStartFinish()：正式开局的时机统一交给文件末尾的"每次求值"决定，
    --   因为三国杀模式要先走完「偏好投票 + 发身份」才允许开局（docs/11 §3）
end

-- ②.5 三国杀专用：偏好投票要先能点按钮，所以"解锁相机 + 开输入 + 收公告"要提前做
function ChoukaStartFinishFront()
    ChoukaStartLockCamera(0)
    if type(ExecuteAction) == "function" then
        ExecuteAction("ENABLE_INPUT")
    end
    if type(exHideLongTextDialog) == "function" then
        exHideLongTextDialog()
    end
    if type(exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer) == "function" then
        exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer(ChoukaStartHost)
    end
    return 1
end

-- ③ 正式开始：视角回自己出生点、解锁、发钱、倒计时起步
--    ⚠ 顺序有讲究：标志位与"钱/倒计时"先做，关窗口、挪相机这类装饰性动作放后面 ——
--      Lua 4.0 没有 pcall，万一中间某一句报错，也不会把"发钱"这个关键动作挡掉。
function ChoukaStartFinish()
    ChoukaStartStage = 2
    CHOUKA_GAME_STARTED = 1
    -- 33 号节点（胜负判定）从这一刻开始工作。
    -- ★ 故意放在最前面而不是函数末尾：Lua 4.0 没有 pcall，后面任何一句报错都不该
    --   把"判胜负"这件事一起废掉（身份和座位早就发好了，判定所需数据是齐的）。
    ChoukaBangStartApplied = 1

    -- 抽卡范围：按房主在配置页选的那一档写进全局（12_puredraw_replace 抽池时读它）
    local scopeOpt = ChoukaStartScopeOptions[ChoukaStartScopeKey]
    if scopeOpt ~= nil and scopeOpt.scope ~= nil then
        CHOUKA_DRAW_SCOPE = scopeOpt.scope
    end

    -- 盲盒倒计时从整轮开始走（02_private_box.lua 每秒减 1）
    CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT = CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS
    CHOUKA_ROUND = 0
    ExecuteAction("SET_MILLISECOND_TIMER", "box", CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS)

    -- 解相机锁 + 开输入
    ChoukaStartLockCamera(0)
    ExecuteAction("ENABLE_INPUT")

    -- 视角回归自己的出生点（起重机就在旁边）
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        ExecuteAction("PLAYER_CAMERA_MOVE_TO", "Player_" .. i,
            "Player_" .. i .. "_Start", 0, 0, 0, 0)
    end

    -- 恢复右下角单位操作区
    if type(exAptShowObjectDetailsArea) == "function" then
        exAptShowObjectDetailsArea()
    end

    -- 关掉可能还开着的公告 / 配置窗口（有人没点「已阅读」也一并收掉）
    if type(exHideLongTextDialog) == "function" then
        exHideLongTextDialog()
    end
    if type(exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer) == "function" then
        exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer(ChoukaStartHost)
    end

    -- 全图公告：房主到底选了什么（所有人都会在左下角消息区看到）
    local scopeText = ChoukaT.scopeAll
    if CHOUKA_DRAW_SCOPE == 1 then
        scopeText = ChoukaT.scopeOwn
    end
    ChoukaStartBroadcast(format(ChoukaT.hostConfigDone, scopeText, CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS), 20)
    if CHOUKA_MODE == 1 then
        ChoukaStartBroadcast(ChoukaT.bangStartGo, 20)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- 3. 回调
-- ============================================================

-- 长文本对话框（公告）：所有人点「已阅读」→ 房主开配置页面，其他人继续等
function ChoukaLongText_start(playerName, btnIndex, dialogId)
    if dialogId ~= CHOUKA_START_ANNOUNCE_DIALOG then
        return 0
    end
    if type(exHideLongTextDialogForPlayer) == "function" then
        exHideLongTextDialogForPlayer(playerName)
    end
    ChoukaStartRefreshHost()
    if playerName == ChoukaStartHost then
        ChoukaStartShowHostDialog(playerName)
        ChoukaStartTellPlayer(playerName,
            ChoukaT.hostTip, 20)
    else
        ChoukaStartTellPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_START_WAIT_TEXT, 20)
    end
    return 1
end

-- 按钮对话框（房主配置）：
--   1..scopeN            = 箱子范围二选一
--   scopeN+1..scopeN+modeN = 玩法二选一（默认 / 三国杀）
--   +1 = 确认，开始游戏      +2 = 重新查看公告
function ChoukaChoice_start(playerName, btnIndex, dialogId)
    if dialogId ~= CHOUKA_START_HOST_DIALOG then
        return 0
    end
    -- 只有房主能操作这个窗口
    if playerName ~= ChoukaStartHost then
        return 1
    end

    local scopeN = getn(ChoukaStartScopeOptions)
    local modeN = getn(ChoukaStartModeOptions)
    local confirmBtn = scopeN + modeN + 1
    local rereadBtn = scopeN + modeN + 2

    if btnIndex >= 1 and btnIndex <= scopeN then
        ChoukaStartScopeKey = btnIndex
        -- 房主每点一次选项，全图播一条（照 DSA：让所有人知道房主正在选什么）
        local picked = ChoukaStartScopeOptions[btnIndex]
        if picked ~= nil and picked.name ~= nil then
            ChoukaStartBroadcast(format(ChoukaT.hostPicking, picked.name), 8)
        end
        -- 选择对话框点一下就自动消失，所以重开一遍把 √ 标出来
        ChoukaStartShowHostDialog(playerName)
        return 1
    end

    if btnIndex > scopeN and btnIndex <= scopeN + modeN then
        local modeKey = btnIndex - scopeN
        ChoukaStartModeKey = modeKey
        local pickedMode = ChoukaStartModeOptions[modeKey]
        if pickedMode ~= nil then
            -- ★ 点选项就立刻写 CHOUKA_MODE（不等"确认"）：
            --   13_frame_loop 的 3 分钟保险丝靠它立刻让位，见 docs/11 §2③
            CHOUKA_MODE = pickedMode.mode
            if pickedMode.name ~= nil then
                ChoukaStartBroadcast(format(ChoukaT.hostPicking, pickedMode.name), 8)
            end
        end
        ChoukaStartShowHostDialog(playerName)
        return 1
    end

    if btnIndex == confirmBtn then
        ChoukaStartConfirm = 1
        -- 三国杀路径：先弹全员偏好面板，等投票 + 发身份走完才正式开局
        if CHOUKA_MODE == 1 then
            ChoukaStartBangPath = 1
            -- ⚠ 顺序有讲究：ChoukaStartFinishFront() 会调 exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer(房主)，
            --   而那个接口是"关掉该玩家当前的按钮对话框"、不区分 id。
            --   如果先弹偏好面板再收尾，房主自己的偏好面板会被一起关掉。
            --   所以：先收尾（关配置页），后弹偏好面板。
            ChoukaStartFinishFront()
            if type(ChoukaBangBeginPreference) == "function" then
                ChoukaBangBeginPreference()
            else
                -- 偏好模块没加载（脚本报错/节点没导入）：退化成纯随机，别让整局卡死
                ChoukaAlert(ChoukaT.bangPrefNoModule)
                ChoukaBangPrefDone = 1
            end
        end
        if type(exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer) == "function" then
            -- 房主点完确认，配置页收掉（上面 FinishFront 已经收过一次，这里幂等）
            -- 注意：三国杀路径下这时候房主屏幕上开着的可能是"身份偏好"面板，
            -- 所以只在非三国杀模式下才由这里关。
            if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 then
                exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer(playerName)
            end
        end
        return 1
    end

    if btnIndex == rereadBtn then
        if type(exShowLongTextDialogForPlayer) == "function" then
            exShowLongTextDialogForPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_START_ANNOUNCE_DIALOG,
                CHOUKA_START_ANNOUNCE_TEXT, "", ChoukaT.readDone, "")
        end
        return 1
    end
    return 1
end

-- ⚠ 只注册一次：脚本每次求值都会重新"定义"一遍函数（新的函数对象），
--   无脑 tinsert 会让处理函数表每秒变长，所以用标志位卡住。
if ChoukaStartHandlersRegistered ~= 1 then
    ChoukaStartHandlersRegistered = 1
    ChoukaAddLongTextHandler(ChoukaLongText_start)
    ChoukaAddChoiceHandler(ChoukaChoice_start)
end

-- ============================================================
-- 4. 每次求值
-- ============================================================

if CHOUKA_GAME_STARTED == 1 then
    -- 已经开局：本节点只剩"让上面两个回调一直存在"的作用，什么都不做
elseif ChoukaStartStage == 0 then
    ChoukaStartBegin()
elseif ChoukaStartBangPath == 1 then
    -- 三国杀路径：相机已在 ChoukaStartFinishFront 里解锁，这里不再重钉视角，
    -- 只等 32 号节点投完票（ChoukaBangPrefDone）+ 30 号节点发完身份（ChoukaBangRolesReady）
    if ChoukaBangPrefDone == 1 and ChoukaBangRolesReady == 1 then
        ChoukaStartFinish()
    end
else
    ChoukaStartWaitTick()
    if ChoukaStartConfirm == 1 then
        ChoukaStartFinish()
    end
end

-- ① 公屏 / 计分板 / 消息区用：真实昵称；拿不到就退回 $p<N>Name（这些通道会替换）
function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end

-- 留着它就会一直往图上刷箱子，哪怕它正好落在某个点位旁边。
CHOUKA_CRATE_SPAWNER = "GenericCrateSpawner"

-- 本图自己的箱子只会出现在这些点位上
-- （02_private_box.lua 的两组家庭箱点 + 06_center.lua 的中央七点 `center`+`center1~6`）
-- （box1~box6 是老写法，留着兜底；实际航点是 box11~box62）
-- ⚠ `center` 必须在这张表里：否则我们自己刷在中心点的盲盒会被下面的清理逻辑当成自然随机箱删掉
CHOUKA_CRATE_KEEP_WPS = {

    [4]  = "box4",   [5]  = "box5",   [6]  = "box6",

ChoukaCrateSweptTotal = ChoukaCrateSweptTotal or 0

-- ============================================================
-- 1. 小工具
-- ============================================================

-- 自然箱子过滤器（建一次就缓存；类型表改了要重新进游戏才生效）
function ChoukaCrateFilterNatural()
    if ChoukaCrateNaturalFilter == nil then
        ChoukaCrateNaturalFilter = CreateObjectFilter({
            Rule = "ANY",
            IncludeThing = CHOUKA_CRATE_NATURAL,
        })
    end
    return ChoukaCrateNaturalFilter
end

-- 只认生成器的过滤器（第 1 帧 + 每次兜底都用它）
function ChoukaCrateFilterSpawner()
    if ChoukaCrateSpawnerFilter == nil then
        ChoukaCrateSpawnerFilter = CreateObjectFilter({
            Rule = "ANY",
            IncludeThing = { CHOUKA_CRATE_SPAWNER },
        })
    end
    return ChoukaCrateSpawnerFilter
end

-- 这个坐标离某个预设刷箱点位近不近（近 = 自家箱子，不删）
-- ⚠ exWaypointGetPos 返回**数组**（p[1]/p[2]/p[3]），不是 p.X
function ChoukaCrateNearKeepPoint(x, y)
    if x == nil or y == nil then
        return 0
    end
    local limit = CHOUKA_CRATE_KEEP_RANGE * CHOUKA_CRATE_KEEP_RANGE
    for i = 1, getn(CHOUKA_CRATE_KEEP_WPS), 1 do
        local p = exWaypointGetPos(CHOUKA_CRATE_KEEP_WPS[i])
        if p ~= nil and p[1] ~= nil and p[2] ~= nil then
            local dx = x - p[1]
            local dy = y - p[2]
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy) <= limit then
                return 1
            end
        end
    end
    return 0
end

-- ============================================================
-- 2. 清扫
-- ============================================================

-- ① 删生成器（DSA 第 1 帧那一段）。返回删掉的个数。
function ChoukaCrateKillSpawners()
    local filter = ChoukaCrateFilterSpawner()
    local units, count = ObjectFindObjects(nil, nil, filter)
    if count == nil or count <= 0 then
        return 0
    end
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        if units[i] ~= nil then
            ExecuteAction("NAMED_DELETE", units[i])
        end
    end
    return count
end

-- ② 扫实体箱子（DSA 第 45 帧那一段 + 保留点位判断）。返回删掉的个数。
--    每次都先把生成器再清一遍：引擎有时会更晚才把生成器补上。
function ChoukaCrateSweep()
    local removed = ChoukaCrateKillSpawners()
    local filter = ChoukaCrateFilterNatural()
    local units, count = ObjectFindObjects(nil, nil, filter)
    if count == nil or count <= 0 then
        return removed
    end
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        local obj = units[i]
        if obj ~= nil then
            local x, y, z = ObjectGetPosition(obj)
            if ChoukaCrateNearKeepPoint(x, y) == 0 then
                ExecuteAction("NAMED_DELETE", obj)
                removed = removed + 1
            end
        end
    end
    return removed
end

-- ============================================================
-- 3. 每次求值（每帧）：靠自己的帧计数决定活干不干
-- ============================================================

ChoukaCrateTick = ChoukaCrateTick + 1

if ChoukaCrateTick == CHOUKA_CRATE_FIRST_TICK then
    -- 第 1 帧：删生成器；顺便记下"大厅开没开随机箱子"（以后要联动别的系统可以用）
    local killed = ChoukaCrateKillSpawners()
    if killed > 0 then
        CHOUKA_LOBBY_CRATE_ON = 1
        ChoukaCrateSweptTotal = ChoukaCrateSweptTotal + killed
    end
elseif ChoukaCrateTick == CHOUKA_CRATE_SECOND_TICK then
    -- 第 45 帧：把开局已经落地的实体箱子也清掉（自家点位上的一律放过）
    local removed = ChoukaCrateSweep()
    ChoukaCrateSweptTotal = ChoukaCrateSweptTotal + removed
    if removed > 0 then
        ChoukaAlert(format(ChoukaT.crateCleaned, removed))
    end
elseif ChoukaCrateTick > CHOUKA_CRATE_SECOND_TICK
    and ChoukaCrateTick <= CHOUKA_CRATE_SWEEP_UNTIL
    and mod(ChoukaCrateTick, CHOUKA_CRATE_SWEEP_EVERY) == 0 then
    -- 兜底：个别箱子可能比开局动画还晚落地，前 2 分钟每 10 秒补扫一次
    ChoukaCrateSweptTotal = ChoukaCrateSweptTotal + ChoukaCrateSweep()
end

function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)

--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end

--   Lv1 开局自带 / 1000 / 2000 / 5000 / 10000 / 20000 / 50000 / 50000

    [2] = 1000,

    [7] = 50000,
    [8] = 50000,

-- 第几个回合结束后自动升到该级（键 = 目标等级）
ChoukaAutoLevelRound = {
    [2] = 5,
    [3] = 10,
    [4] = 15,
    [5] = 20,
}

function ChoukaGetLevelWeights(level)
    local weights = ChoukaLevelWeights[level]
    if weights == nil then
        weights = ChoukaLevelWeights[1]
    end
    return weights
end

-- 升到 level 的价格（nil = 已满级）
function ChoukaGetLevelPrice(level)
    return ChoukaLevelPrice[level]
end

-- 每刷一轮箱子（回合 +1）后调用：到点自动升级 + 全图播报
function ChoukaAutoLevelTick(round)
    if round == nil then
        return
    end
    for level, atRound in ChoukaAutoLevelRound do
        -- 只在"当前等级更低"时升级，绝不把已经买上去的等级压下来
        if round >= atRound and ChoukaDrawLevel < level then
            ChoukaDrawLevel = level
            ChoukaAlert(format(ChoukaT.levelAutoUp, level))
        end
    end
end

-- 升一级（购买）。返回 1=成功 / 0=失败，第二个返回是提示文字
function ChoukaBuyLevel(playerName)
    local nextLevel = ChoukaDrawLevel + 1
    local price = ChoukaGetLevelPrice(nextLevel)
    if price == nil then
        return 0, format(ChoukaT.levelMax, ChoukaDrawLevel)
    end
    local money = exPlayerGetCurrentMoney(playerName)
    if money == nil then
        money = 0
    end
    if money < price then
        return 0, format(ChoukaT.levelNoMoney, nextLevel, price)
    end
    ExecuteAction("PLAYER_GIVE_MONEY", playerName, -price)
    ChoukaDrawLevel = nextLevel
    return 1, format(ChoukaT.levelUp, ChoukaDrawLevel)
end

#!ra3luabridge
-- ============================================================

if _LOG == nil then
    function _LOG(msg)
        if type(exPrintln) == "function" then
            exPrintln("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
        end
    end
end

if _ALERT == nil then
    function _ALERT(msg)
        _LOG(msg)
        if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
            exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
        end
        if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
            exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
        end
    end
end

-- ★ 我方播报用独占名字，绝不抢通用全局名（全局 _ALERT 已被本图别的脚本占用且是哑的）
--   完整来龙去脉见 docs/03 §8「不要去抢通用全局名」；新代码一律用 ChoukaAlert / ChoukaAlertFor。

function ChoukaAlert(msg)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    -- ① 日志（唯一确认可靠的通道，必须第一个调）
    _LOG(msg)
    -- ② 左下消息区
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    -- ③ 公屏（全场可见，阵亡通报/占领播报靠它）
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
    end
end

-- 带显示时长的版本（公告类用长一点）
function ChoukaAlertFor(msg, seconds)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    _LOG(msg)
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        if seconds == nil then
            seconds = 10
        end
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, seconds)
    end
end

-- 真实昵称缓存：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 查到的玩家名（查一次就记住）
ChoukaPlayerNames = ChoukaPlayerNames or {}

-- ① 公屏 / 计分板 / 消息区用：真实昵称；拿不到就退回 $p<N>Name（这些通道会替换）
function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end

function ChoukaMarkNodeReady(nodeName)
    if ChoukaNodeReady[nodeName] == nil then
        ChoukaNodeReady[nodeName] = 1
        _LOG("节点就绪：" .. nodeName)
    end
end

-- 已经就绪的节点名，拼成一行字符串（给心跳日志用）
function ChoukaNodeReadyList()
    local list = ""
    for name, flag in ChoukaNodeReady do
        if list == "" then
            list = name
        else
            list = list .. "," .. name
        end
    end
    if list == "" then
        return "无"
    end
    return list
end

local OIL_INCOME         = 20   -- 自己的私油井 oilN $/秒

local BASE_POWER         = 100000

-- 三国杀模式：主公底薪倍率（20 → 30）。油井 / 中央油井不受影响，见 docs/11 §8
CHOUKA_BANG_LORD_INCOME_MULT = CHOUKA_BANG_LORD_INCOME_MULT or 1.5

-- 经济倍率（读不到就按 1）
local choukaMult = 1
if type(exModeGetCheatMultiplier) == "function" then
    choukaMult = exModeGetCheatMultiplier()
    if choukaMult == nil or choukaMult <= 0 then
        choukaMult = 1
    end
end
CHOUKA_ECONOMY_MULT = choukaMult       -- 给其它脚本（中央油井播报）看

local baseIncome       = floor(BASE_INCOME * choukaMult)
local oilIncome        = floor(OIL_INCOME * choukaMult)
local centerOilIncome  = floor(CENTER_OIL_INCOME * choukaMult)

for i = 1, 6, 1 do
    local playerName = "Player_" .. i
    local crane = GetObjectByScriptName("crane" .. i)
    if ObjectIsAlive(crane) then

        -- 1) 底薪

        end
        ExecuteAction("PLAYER_GIVE_MONEY", playerName, floor(baseIncome * lordMult))

        -- 2) 电力每轮重设，防止被其它逻辑改回去
        ExecuteAction("PLAYER_SET_BASE_POWER", playerName, BASE_POWER)

        -- 3) 私油井加成

                             playerName, 4, 0, "OilDerrick", "Total") then
            ExecuteAction("PLAYER_GIVE_MONEY", playerName, oilIncome)

                end
            end
            if mine > 0 then
                ExecuteAction("PLAYER_GIVE_MONEY", playerName, centerOilIncome * mine)
            end
        end
    end
end

if _LOG == nil then

        _LOG(msg)

            exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
        end
        if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then

        end

-- ★ 我方播报用独占名字，绝不抢通用全局名（全局 _ALERT 已被本图别的脚本占用且是哑的）
--   完整来龙去脉见 docs/03 §8「不要去抢通用全局名」；新代码一律用 ChoukaAlert / ChoukaAlertFor。

function ChoukaAlert(msg)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    -- ① 日志（唯一确认可靠的通道，必须第一个调）
    _LOG(msg)
    -- ② 左下消息区
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    -- ③ 公屏（全场可见，阵亡通报/占领播报靠它）
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
    end
end

-- 带显示时长的版本（公告类用长一点）
function ChoukaAlertFor(msg, seconds)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    _LOG(msg)
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        if seconds == nil then
            seconds = 10
        end
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, seconds)
    end
end

-- 真实昵称缓存：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 查到的玩家名（查一次就记住）
ChoukaPlayerNames = ChoukaPlayerNames or {}

-- ① 公屏 / 计分板 / 消息区用：真实昵称；拿不到就退回 $p<N>Name（这些通道会替换）
function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end

ChoukaNodeReady = ChoukaNodeReady or {}

function ChoukaMarkNodeReady(nodeName)
    if ChoukaNodeReady[nodeName] == nil then
        ChoukaNodeReady[nodeName] = 1
        _LOG("节点就绪：" .. nodeName)
    end
end

-- 已经就绪的节点名，拼成一行字符串（给心跳日志用）
function ChoukaNodeReadyList()
    local list = ""
    for name, flag in ChoukaNodeReady do
        if list == "" then
            list = name
        else
            list = list .. "," .. name
        end
    end
    if list == "" then
        return "无"
    end
    return list
end

--   ② 07_crates.lua 只删"预设点位 80 世界单位以外"的引擎随机箱，所以这里刷的箱子不会被误删；
--   ③ 治疗箱（HealCrateMP）只放在中央表里，家里不刷。
-- ============================================================

-- 中央 center + center1~6：好箱子概率高一点（治疗箱只在中央）
CHOUKA_CENTER_CRATE_TABLE = CHOUKA_CENTER_CRATE_TABLE or {
    [1] = { type = "moneycrate",       weight = 60, name = "现金箱" },
    [2] = { type = "MoneyCrate_200",   weight = 5,  name = "大现金箱" },
    [3] = { type = "HealCrateMP",      weight = 5,  name = "治疗箱（只在中央刷）" },
    [4] = { type = "VeterancyCrateMP", weight = 5,  name = "经验箱" },
    [5] = { type = "RandomCrate",      weight = 10, name = "神秘箱" },
    [6] = { type = "UnitCrateNew",     weight = 5,  name = "部队箱" },
    [7] = { type = "AttributeCrate",   weight = 10, name = "属性箱（临时增益）" },
    [8] = { type = "BombCrate",        weight = 0,  name = "炸弹箱（陷阱，会炸伤捡箱子的兵）" },
}

-- 家里的 boxN1 / boxN2：没有治疗箱
CHOUKA_BOX_CRATE_TABLE = CHOUKA_BOX_CRATE_TABLE or {
    [1] = { type = "moneycrate",       weight = 60, name = "现金箱" },
    [2] = { type = "MoneyCrate_200",   weight = 10, name = "大现金箱" },
    [3] = { type = "VeterancyCrateMP", weight = 5,  name = "经验箱" },
    [4] = { type = "RandomCrate",      weight = 10, name = "神秘箱" },
    [5] = { type = "UnitCrateNew",     weight = 5,  name = "部队箱" },
    [6] = { type = "AttributeCrate",   weight = 10, name = "属性箱（临时增益）" },
    [7] = { type = "BombCrate",        weight = 0,  name = "炸弹箱（陷阱，会炸伤捡箱子的兵）" },
}

CHOUKA_BOX_CRATE_LOG = 1    -- 1 = 每刷一个箱子就往日志里记一行"哪个点位·哪个类型"

-- 取一张表：kind = "home"（家里，默认）/ "center"（中央）
function ChoukaBoxCrateTable(kind)
    if kind == "center" then
        return CHOUKA_CENTER_CRATE_TABLE
    end
    return CHOUKA_BOX_CRATE_TABLE
end

-- 两张表里所有"会刷出来"的类型名（点位占用过滤器要用，自动去重）
function ChoukaBoxCrateTypeList()
    local list = {}
    local seen = {}
    local tables = { CHOUKA_BOX_CRATE_TABLE, CHOUKA_CENTER_CRATE_TABLE }
    for t = 1, getn(tables), 1 do
        local tbl = tables[t]
        if tbl ~= nil then
            for i = 1, getn(tbl), 1 do
                local item = tbl[i]
                if item ~= nil and item.type ~= nil and (item.weight or 0) > 0
                    and seen[item.type] == nil then
                    seen[item.type] = 1
                    tinsert(list, item.type)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end

-- 按权重随机挑一种；kind = "home"（默认）/ "center"；表里全 0 时退回现金箱
function ChoukaPickBoxCrate(kind)
    local tbl = ChoukaBoxCrateTable(kind)
    if tbl == nil then
        return "moneycrate"
    end
    local total = 0
    for i = 1, getn(tbl), 1 do
        local item = tbl[i]
        if item ~= nil and item.type ~= nil and (item.weight or 0) > 0 then
            total = total + item.weight
        end
    end
    if total <= 0 then
        return "moneycrate"
    end
    local roll = GetRandomNumber() * total
    local acc = 0
    for i = 1, getn(tbl), 1 do
        local item = tbl[i]
        if item ~= nil and item.type ~= nil and (item.weight or 0) > 0 then
            acc = acc + item.weight
            if roll < acc then
                return item.type
            end
        end
    end
    return "moneycrate"
end

-- 类型名 → 中文名（只用于日志；两张表都查）
function ChoukaBoxCrateName(crateType)
    local tables = { CHOUKA_BOX_CRATE_TABLE, CHOUKA_CENTER_CRATE_TABLE }
    for t = 1, getn(tables), 1 do
        local tbl = tables[t]
        if tbl ~= nil then
            for i = 1, getn(tbl), 1 do
                local item = tbl[i]
                if item ~= nil and item.type == crateType then
                    return item.name or crateType
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return crateType
end

-- ============================================================
-- ★ 每回合开始：给场上所有飞机补满弹药（作者要求：只补满、**不播报**，免得刷屏）
--   接口见《日冕 Lua.lua》[[34]]：
--     ObjectGetWeaponSetUpdateWeaponMaxAmmoCount(单位, WeaponSlot 的 ID, Ordering, 武器序号)
--     ObjectSetWeaponSetUpdateWeaponCurrentAmmoCount(单位, WeaponSlot 的 ID, Ordering, 武器序号, 数值)
--   Ordering：PRIMARY=1 SECONDARY=2 TERTIARY=3 QUATERNARY=4 QUINARY=5
--   ⚠ "WeaponSlot 的 ID" 不是槽位序号；飞机主武器一般在 ID=1 的槽里，所以默认扫 1~2 号槽。
-- ============================================================
CHOUKA_AMMO_REFILL = 1      -- 1 = 每回合开始补满（改 0 关掉）
CHOUKA_AMMO_SLOTS  = 2      -- 扫几个 WeaponSlot（ID 1~2）
CHOUKA_AMMO_ORDERS = 5      -- PRIMARY ~ QUINARY
CHOUKA_AMMO_INDEX  = 6      -- 每个 Ordering 里最多几个武器
CHOUKA_AMMO_RADIUS = 20000  -- 找飞机的搜索半径（够包住整张图）

if ChoukaRefillAircraftAmmo == nil then
    function ChoukaRefillAircraftAmmo()
        if CHOUKA_AMMO_REFILL ~= 1 then
            return 0
        end
        if type(ObjectFindObjects) ~= "function" then
            return 0
        end
        if type(ObjectSetWeaponSetUpdateWeaponCurrentAmmoCount) ~= "function" then
            _LOG("补弹药：这个 mod 没有 ObjectSetWeaponSetUpdateWeaponCurrentAmmoCount，跳过")
            return 0
        end

        if ChoukaAircraftFilter == nil then
            ChoukaAircraftFilter = CreateObjectFilter({
                Rule = "ANY",
                Relationship = "ENEMIES NEUTRAL ALLIES",
                Include = "AIRCRAFT",
            })
        end
        local objs, count = ObjectFindObjects(nil, {
            X = 0, Y = 0, Z = 0,
            Radius = CHOUKA_AMMO_RADIUS,
            DistType = "EXTENTS_3D",
        }, ChoukaAircraftFilter)
        if count == nil or count < 1 then
            _LOG(format("补弹药：第%d回合，场上没有飞机", CHOUKA_ROUND or 0))
            return 0
        end

        local hasMax = (type(ObjectGetWeaponSetUpdateWeaponMaxAmmoCount) == "function")
        local planes = 0
        local weapons = 0
        for i = 1, count, 1 do
            local obj = objs[i]
            if obj ~= nil and ObjectIsAlive(obj) then
                planes = planes + 1
                for slot = 1, CHOUKA_AMMO_SLOTS, 1 do
                    for ord = 1, CHOUKA_AMMO_ORDERS, 1 do
                        for idx = 1, CHOUKA_AMMO_INDEX, 1 do
                            local maxAmmo = nil
                            if hasMax then
                                maxAmmo = ObjectGetWeaponSetUpdateWeaponMaxAmmoCount(obj, slot, ord, idx)
                            end
                            if type(maxAmmo) == "number" and maxAmmo > 0 then
                                ObjectSetWeaponSetUpdateWeaponCurrentAmmoCount(obj, slot, ord, idx, maxAmmo)
                                weapons = weapons + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        _LOG(format("补弹药：第%d回合，飞机 %d 架，补满武器 %d 处",
            CHOUKA_ROUND or 0, planes, weapons))
        return planes
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- ★ 登神盲盒（AttributeCrate = 通用木箱 NPCrate01，原版捡起来没任何效果）
--   箱子被碰掉（销毁）时：给"箱子点位附近小范围里、箱子主人的单位"加一项属性 buff，
--   并且只给箱子主人一个人播报一句。掷骰与接口都照 DSA 自走棋的"登神"
--   （DSA_ggz自走棋/lua/GAME/HextechRune/06_ascension.lua）：
--     概率：血量 40% / 伤害 30% / 攻速 20% / 射程 10%（累计 0.40 / 0.70 / 0.90 / 1.00）
--     幅度：25% ~ 50%（本图自定义；DSA 是按阶级 30/40/50/60）
--     接口：exAttributeModifierCreate({ ... }, 1) + ObjectLoadAttributeModifier(单位, mod, 秒)
--   累计：**同一个单位吃两次同一种加成会叠上去**（登记表 + 引擎查询双保险，见下面 ChoukaAscendPushStack）
--   ⚠ 只影响"箱子周围 CHOUKA_ASCEND_RADIUS 以内"的单位（一般 3~5 个），不是玩家全部单位。
-- ============================================================
CHOUKA_ASCEND_TYPE     = "AttributeCrate"   -- 登神盲盒 = 属性箱（模型 NPCrate01）
CHOUKA_ASCEND_RADIUS   = 96                 -- 生效半径（世界单位）= 作者定的基准：家里 box11↔box12 的间距 95.5
                                            -- （(5066,4310)→(5136,4245)，dx70 dy65）。直径 192 ≈ 两个箱子点的跨度。
CHOUKA_ASCEND_MIN      = 25                 -- 幅度下限 %
CHOUKA_ASCEND_MAX      = 50                 -- 幅度上限 %
CHOUKA_ASCEND_DURATION = 999999999          -- 持续**帧数**（LuaBridge 的第三个参数是帧，30 帧 = 1 秒）
                                            -- DSA 登神写 9999（≈5.5 分钟），巨人城废墟-登神参考工程写
                                            -- permanent_frame_count = 999999999，这里照后者 = 整局不消
CHOUKA_ASCEND_LOG      = 1                  -- 1 = 每次结算写一行日志

ChoukaAscendBoxes = ChoukaAscendBoxes or {}   -- 箱子对象 id → { player=…, x=…, y=…, z=…, waypoint=… }

-- 从 team 名（Player_3/teamPlayer_3）里取出玩家名
function ChoukaTeamPlayerName(team)
    if team == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local pos = strfind(team, "/")
    if pos == nil then
        return team
    end
    return strsub(team, 1, pos - 1)
end

-- 箱子类型哈希集合（把"箱子自己"从加成目标里排除，纯 Lua 比较，不额外依赖过滤器）
function ChoukaCrateHashSet()
    if ChoukaCrateHashes ~= nil then
        return ChoukaCrateHashes
    end
    -- 本文件里 ChoukaCrateFilterTypes 定义在更下面（第一次求值时可能还没轮到），
    -- 那种情况下**不要缓存空表**，下次再算
    if type(ChoukaCrateFilterTypes) ~= "function" then
        return {}
    end
    ChoukaCrateHashes = {}
    local list = ChoukaCrateFilterTypes()
    for i = 1, getn(list), 1 do
        ChoukaCrateHashes[FastHash(list[i])] = 1
    end
    return ChoukaCrateHashes
end

-- 箱子刷出来后登记（只登记登神盲盒）：记下箱子对象 id、点位、归属玩家
function ChoukaRegisterAscendBox(team, waypoint)
    if type(ObjectFindObjects) ~= "function" then
        return
    end
    local p = exWaypointGetPos(waypoint)
    if p == nil or p[1] == nil then
        return
    end
    if ChoukaAscendBoxFilter == nil then
        ChoukaAscendBoxFilter = CreateObjectFilter({
            Rule = "ANY",
            IncludeThing = { CHOUKA_ASCEND_TYPE },
        })
    end
    local objs, count = ObjectFindObjects(nil, {
        X = p[1], Y = p[2], Z = p[3] or 0,
        Radius = 20, DistType = "CENTER_2D",
    }, ChoukaAscendBoxFilter)
    if count == nil or count < 1 then
        _LOG(format("登神盲盒：%s 刷出来了但没找到箱子对象（不会触发加成播报）", waypoint))
        return
    end
    local playerName = ChoukaTeamPlayerName(team)
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        local obj = objs[i]
        if obj ~= nil and ObjectIsAlive(obj) then
            ChoukaAscendBoxes[ObjectGetId(obj)] = {
                player = playerName,
                x = p[1], y = p[2], z = p[3] or 0,
                waypoint = waypoint,
            }
        end
    end
end

-- 掷一次：返回 种类, 中文名, 幅度%
function ChoukaRollAscend()
    local roll = GetRandomNumber()
    local kind = "health"
    local kindName = ChoukaT.ascendHealth
    if roll < 0.40 then
        kind = "health"
        kindName = ChoukaT.ascendHealth
    elseif roll < 0.70 then
        kind = "damage"
        kindName = ChoukaT.ascendDamage
    elseif roll < 0.90 then
        kind = "rateOfFire"
        kindName = ChoukaT.ascendRate
    else
        kind = "range"
        kindName = ChoukaT.ascendRange
    end
    local span = CHOUKA_ASCEND_MAX - CHOUKA_ASCEND_MIN + 1
    local percent = CHOUKA_ASCEND_MIN + floor(GetRandomNumber() * span)
    if percent > CHOUKA_ASCEND_MAX then
        percent = CHOUKA_ASCEND_MAX
    end
    if percent < CHOUKA_ASCEND_MIN then
        percent = CHOUKA_ASCEND_MIN
    end
    return kind, kindName, percent
end

-- ============================================================
-- 登神累计：单位登记表 + 引擎查询，把"再吃一次同种加成"变成"在原有加成上往上加"
--
-- 为什么要这么写：
--   · 引擎里每条 AttributeModifier 是**相乘**的，所以"再加 40%"如果直接再挂一条，
--     结果是 1.4 × 1.4 = 1.96（+96%），而不是累计想要的 1.8（+80%）；
--   · 想累计成"1 + 已有% + 这次%"这一条，只能重算——但卸载旧 modifier 的接口在
--     exAttributeModifierCreate 造出来的对象上不一定好使（DSA 干脆一次重算一条）。
-- 所以这里用"**补差额倍数**"的写法，不用卸载：
--   已有倍数 = 1 + 这只单位这一维**已经吃到的累计%** / 100   ← 只用登记表，绝不查引擎
--   目标倍数 = 1 + (已有% + 本次%) / 100
--   补的倍数 = 目标倍数 / 已有倍数  → 新挂一条
--   因为 modifier 相乘：已有 × 补 = 目标，累计语义与 DSA 的"1 + n×p%"完全一致。
-- 好处：
--   ① 不需要卸载接口；
--   ② **乘法链天然可叠**：单位吃 N 次就是 1×d1×d2×…×dN = 1 + Σp%，想叠多少叠多少；
--   ③ 基准只能用**登记表**，不能用 ObjectGetAttributeModifier 的实时值 ——
--      实时值里混着协议/技能等外部 buff，拿它当分母会把登神的加成"稀释"掉
--      （例：外部已有 +40%，我们目标 +41%，若用 1.4 当分母只补 1.007，
--        玩家实际只多得 0.7%，而不是应得的 41%）。引擎实时值只在日志里输出用于核对；
--   ④ 登记表还能给日志报出"这只单位现在累计多少"。
-- ============================================================
ChoukaAscendUnitStacks = ChoukaAscendUnitStacks or {}   -- 单位对象 id → { health=Σ%, damage=Σ%, rateOfFire=Σ%, range=Σ% }

-- 掷骰种类 → 引擎属性键（查询/创建同名）
function ChoukaAscendAttrKey(kind)
    if kind == "health" then
        return "HEALTH_MULT"
    elseif kind == "damage" then
        return "DAMAGE_MULT"
    elseif kind == "rateOfFire" then
        return "RATE_OF_FIRE"
    end
    return "RANGE"
end

-- 取这只单位的登记记录（没有就建一条）
function ChoukaAscendUnitRecord(unitId)
    local rec = ChoukaAscendUnitStacks[unitId]
    if rec == nil then
        rec = { health = 0, damage = 0, rateOfFire = 0, range = 0 }
        ChoukaAscendUnitStacks[unitId] = rec
    end
    return rec
end

-- 引擎里这只单位这一维现在的实际倍数。**只用来打日志核对**，不参与增量计算
-- （原因见文件开头 ③：实时值里混着外部 buff，当分母会把登神加成稀释掉）
function ChoukaAscendCurrentMult(unit, kind, fallback)
    if type(ObjectGetAttributeModifier) == "function" then
        local cur = nil
        if type(ChoukaAscendAttrKey) == "function" then
            cur = ObjectGetAttributeModifier(unit, ChoukaAscendAttrKey(kind))
        end
        if cur ~= nil and cur > 0 then
            return cur
        end
    end
    return fallback
end

-- 把这一维的累计从"登记表旧值"推到"旧值 + percent"，返回：要补的倍数、新的累计%
--   · 只用登记表当基准（每个单位一条记录，没吃过箱子 = 0）
--   · 补的倍数 = (1 + 新累计%) / (1 + 旧累计%)，连乘起来正好是 1 + 累计%
--     例：第一次 +41% → 挂 1.41；第二次 +41% → 补 1.82/1.41 = 1.2908，
--         引擎里 1.41 × 1.2908 = 1.82（+82%，累计），而不是 1.41 × 1.41 = 1.99
function ChoukaAscendPushStack(unitId, kind, percent)
    local rec = ChoukaAscendUnitRecord(unitId)
    local oldTotal = rec[kind] or 0
    local newTotal = oldTotal + percent
    local oldMult = 1 + oldTotal / 100
    local newMult = 1 + newTotal / 100
    rec[kind] = newTotal
    return newMult / oldMult, newTotal
end

-- 按"种类 + 差值倍数"造一条 modifier（每次新造，避免同一对象重复挂被引擎当成刷新）
function ChoukaAscendMakeModifier(kind, delta)
    if kind == "range" then
        -- 射程必须和视野成对写，否则单位停在射程边缘却看不见目标（DSA 的注释）
        return exAttributeModifierCreate({ RANGE = delta, VISION = delta }, 1)
    end
    if kind == "health" then
        return exAttributeModifierCreate({ HEALTH_MULT = delta }, 1)
    end
    if kind == "damage" then
        return exAttributeModifierCreate({ DAMAGE_MULT = delta }, 1)
    end
    return exAttributeModifierCreate({ RATE_OF_FIRE = delta }, 1)
end

-- 清理登记表里已经死掉的单位（单位 id 会被新单位复用，不清会串加成）
function ChoukaAscendPruneStacks()
    local alive = 0
    for id, rec in ChoukaAscendUnitStacks do
        if rec ~= nil then
            local obj = GetObjectById(id)
            if ObjectIsAlive(obj) then
                alive = alive + 1
            else
                ChoukaAscendUnitStacks[id] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    return alive
end

-- 结算：按箱子点位找附近"箱子主人的"非建筑单位，套上这一项 buff，并给箱主播报
function ChoukaApplyAscendBuff(playerName, x, y, z)
    if type(exAttributeModifierCreate) ~= "function"
        or type(ObjectLoadAttributeModifier) ~= "function" then
        _LOG("登神盲盒：这个 mod 没有 exAttributeModifierCreate / ObjectLoadAttributeModifier，跳过")
        return 0
    end
    if type(ObjectFindObjects) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end

    -- 一只箱子掷一次：种类 + 幅度（同一只箱子罩到的单位拿同一个数，与播报对得上）
    local kind, kindName, percent = ChoukaRollAscend()

    if ChoukaAscendUnitFilter == nil then
        -- 用项目里已验证过的组合（12_puredraw_replace.lua 的 ChoukaDrawPickerFilter 同款）：
        -- 只认能选中的、排除建筑。箱子本身再用类型哈希排掉（见下面 crateHashes）
        ChoukaAscendUnitFilter = CreateObjectFilter({
            Rule = "ANY",
            Include = "SELECTABLE",
            Exclude = "STRUCTURE",
        })
    end
    local objs, count = ObjectFindObjects(nil, {
        X = x, Y = y, Z = z or 0,
        Radius = CHOUKA_ASCEND_RADIUS, DistType = "CENTER_2D",
    }, ChoukaAscendUnitFilter)

    local crateHashes = ChoukaCrateHashSet()
    local buffed = 0
    local maxTotal = 0
    local lastUnit = nil   -- 最后一只被罩到的单位（日志里查引擎真实倍数核对用）
    if count ~= nil and count > 0 then
        for i = 1, count, 1 do
            local u = objs[i]
            if u ~= nil and ObjectIsAlive(u) then
                local owner = nil
                if type(ObjectPlayerScriptName) == "function" then
                    owner = ObjectPlayerScriptName(u)
                end
                if playerName == nil or owner == playerName then
                    local hash = nil
                    if type(exObjectGetInstanceId) == "function" then
                        hash = exObjectGetInstanceId(ObjectGetId(u))
                    end
                    if hash == nil or crateHashes[hash] == nil then
                        local unitId = ObjectGetId(u)
                        local delta, total = ChoukaAscendPushStack(unitId, kind, percent)
                        -- delta 只会在"引擎里已经比目标高"时才等于 1（外部 buff 加过头），
                        -- 那种情况不用再挂一条没用的 modifier，但这个人照样算"被箱子罩到"
                        if delta > 1.001 then
                            local mod = ChoukaAscendMakeModifier(kind, delta)
                            if mod ~= nil then
                                ObjectLoadAttributeModifier(u, mod, CHOUKA_ASCEND_DURATION)
                            end
                        end
                        buffed = buffed + 1
                        lastUnit = u
                        if total > maxTotal then
                            maxTotal = total
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if CHOUKA_ASCEND_LOG == 1 then
        -- 引擎核对值：拿最后一只被罩到的单位查一下引擎真实倍数，
        -- 正常情况下应该 ≈ 1 + 累计%（乘起来了）。对不上就说明引擎不是相乘，要回来改。
        local engineMult = 0
        if lastUnit ~= nil and type(ObjectGetAttributeModifier) == "function" then
            engineMult = ChoukaAscendCurrentMult(lastUnit, kind, 0) or 0
        end
        _LOG(format("登神盲盒：玩家=%s 点位=(%.0f,%.0f) %s +%d%% → %d 个单位（最高累计 %d%%，引擎核对 %.3f）",
            playerName or "?", x, y, kindName, percent, buffed, maxTotal, engineMult))

CHOUKA_CRATE       = "moneycrate"
CHOUKA_BOX_RANGE   = 35       -- 点位占用判定半径（世界单位）；两点相距约 70，别调太大

-- 认作"箱子"的物件类型 = 箱子表(02a_crate_list.lua)里会刷的全部类型 + 两个原版通用箱名。
-- ⚠ 换了箱子种类必须让它出现在这里，否则"这点位还有没有箱子"会判空 → 同一个点越刷越多。
function ChoukaCrateFilterTypes()
    local list = { "UnitCrate", "LuckyUnitCrateSeed" }
    local extra = nil
    if type(ChoukaBoxCrateTypeList) == "function" then
        extra = ChoukaBoxCrateTypeList()
    end
    if extra ~= nil then
        for i = 1, getn(extra), 1 do
            tinsert(list, extra[i])
        end
    elseif CHOUKA_CRATE ~= nil then
        tinsert(list, CHOUKA_CRATE)
    end
    return list
end

ChoukaCrateFilter = ChoukaCrateFilter or CreateObjectFilter({
    Rule = "ANY",
    IncludeThing = ChoukaCrateFilterTypes(),
})

-- 点位是否已经被占用：1 = 有箱子，0 = 空
-- radius 由调用方给（家里两点相距约 70，用 CHOUKA_BOX_RANGE=35；
-- 中央 center1~6 是半径 70 的正六边形，相邻两点只差 ~70/√3≈60，所以中央用小一点的半径）
function ChoukaBoxBusyRange(waypointName, radius)
    if radius == nil then
        radius = CHOUKA_BOX_RANGE
    end
    local p = exWaypointGetPos(waypointName)
    if p == nil then
        return 0                     -- 拿不到坐标就照刷，宁可多刷也别卡住
    end

    -- ⚠ 实测坑：exWaypointGetPos 返回的是**数组**（p[1]/p[2]/p[3]），不是 p.X/p.Y/p.Z。
    --   之前写成 p.X 拿到 nil → ObjectFindObjects 抛错 → 整个"私有箱"脚本中断，
    --   于是箱子不刷、连后面的回合数也不加。下面两种都兼容，谁在就用谁。
    local x = p[1]
    local y = p[2]
    local z = p[3]
    if x == nil then
        x = p.X
    end
    if y == nil then
        y = p.Y
    end
    if z == nil then
        z = p.Z
    end
    if x == nil or y == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if z == nil then
        z = 0
    end

    local TAR, count = ObjectFindObjects(nil, {
        X = x, Y = y, Z = z,
        Radius = radius,
        DistType = "CENTER_2D",
    }, ChoukaCrateFilter)
    if count ~= nil and count > 0 then
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

function ChoukaBoxBusy(waypointName)
    return ChoukaBoxBusyRange(waypointName, CHOUKA_BOX_RANGE)
end

-- ============================================================
-- ① 开局门控：房主还没点确认 → 倒计时冻在整轮，回合数不推进，也不刷箱子
--    三国杀模式结算之后同样停手（CHOUKA_BANG_ENDED 由 33_bang_win.lua 置 1）
-- ============================================================
if CHOUKA_GAME_STARTED ~= 1 or CHOUKA_BANG_ENDED == 1 then
    CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT = CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS
    return
end

-- ============================================================
-- ② 每秒推进盲盒刷新倒计时（HUD 只负责画这个数）
-- ============================================================
if CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT == nil then
    CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT = CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS
end
if CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT > 0 then
    CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT = CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT - 1
end
if CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT > 0 then
    return                            -- 还没到点，这一秒什么都不用做
end

-- ============================================================
-- ③ 倒计时到底 → 开新回合：重置倒计时 + 回合数 +1 + 刷箱子
-- ============================================================
CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT = CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS
CHOUKA_ROUND = (CHOUKA_ROUND or 0) + 1

-- 引擎计时器只用来给别的脚本/控制台看，界面上的倒计时是我们自己数的
ExecuteAction("SET_MILLISECOND_TIMER", "box", CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS)

-- 到点自动升级抽卡等级（第 5/10/15/20 回合 → Lv.2/3/4/5，见 09_level.lua）
if ChoukaAutoLevelTick ~= nil then
    ChoukaAutoLevelTick(CHOUKA_ROUND)
end

-- 在某个点位按 02a_crate_list.lua 的权重表刷一个箱子（家里和中央共用这一个入口）
-- kind：不填 / "home" = 家里的 boxN1·boxN2 表；"center" = 中央 center1~6 表
function ChoukaSpawnBoxCrate(team, waypoint, kind)
    local crateType = "moneycrate"
    if type(ChoukaPickBoxCrate) == "function" then
        crateType = ChoukaPickBoxCrate(kind)
    end
    ExecuteAction("CREATE_UNNAMED_ON_TEAM_AT_WAYPOINT", crateType, team, waypoint)

    -- 登神盲盒要记住"这只箱子是谁的、在哪"，箱子被碰掉才好结算
    if crateType == CHOUKA_ASCEND_TYPE then
        ChoukaRegisterAscendBox(team, waypoint)
    end
    if CHOUKA_BOX_CRATE_LOG == 1 then
        local crateName = crateType
        if type(ChoukaBoxCrateName) == "function" then
            crateName = ChoukaBoxCrateName(crateType)
        end
        local where = "家里"
        if kind == "center" then
            where = "中央"
        end
        _LOG(format("刷箱：%s[%s] 类型=%s（%s）", waypoint, where, crateType, crateName))
    end
end

for i = 1, 6, 1 do
    local playerName = "Player_" .. i
    -- 起重机还在 = 这个座位还在场上（起重机被摧毁时该玩家直接判负）
    local crane = GetObjectByScriptName("crane" .. i)
    if ObjectIsAlive(crane) then
        local team = playerName .. "/team" .. playerName
        local wp1 = "box" .. i .. "1"
        local wp2 = "box" .. i .. "2"
        -- 航点先确认存在，再去扫占用（航点不存在时扫占用会拿 nil 去索引）
        if exWaypointGetPos(wp1) ~= nil and ChoukaBoxBusy(wp1) == 0 then
            ChoukaSpawnBoxCrate(team, wp1, "home")
        end
        if exWaypointGetPos(wp2) ~= nil and ChoukaBoxBusy(wp2) == 0 then
            ChoukaSpawnBoxCrate(team, wp2, "home")
        end
    end
end

function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then

function onUnitCreateEvent(createdObjId, createdObjInstanceId, ownerPlayerName)

        return

    ChoukaAddToBatch(createdObjId, ownerPlayerName, createdObjInstanceId)
end

function ChoukaAlert(msg)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    -- ① 日志（唯一确认可靠的通道，必须第一个调）
    _LOG(msg)
    -- ② 左下消息区

    end

    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
    end
end

-- 带显示时长的版本（公告类用长一点）
function ChoukaAlertFor(msg, seconds)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    _LOG(msg)
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        if seconds == nil then
            seconds = 10
        end
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, seconds)

end

-- 真实昵称缓存：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 查到的玩家名（查一次就记住）
ChoukaPlayerNames = ChoukaPlayerNames or {}

-- ① 公屏 / 计分板 / 消息区用：真实昵称；拿不到就退回 $p<N>Name（这些通道会替换）
function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end

function ChoukaNodeReadyList()
    local list = ""
    for name, flag in ChoukaNodeReady do
        if list == "" then
            list = name
        else
            list = list .. "," .. name
        end
    end
    if list == "" then
        return "无"
    end
    return list
end

-- 世界坐标 (x, y) 是不是水：1 = 水，0 = 陆
function ChoukaMaskIsWater(x, y)
    if x == nil or y == nil then
        return 1                         -- 坐标无效：按水处理（宁可不放陆地单位到海里）
    end
    local px = CHOUKA_MASK_PX_A + CHOUKA_MASK_PX_B * x
    local py = CHOUKA_MASK_PY_A + CHOUKA_MASK_PY_B * y
    local gx = floor(px / CHOUKA_MASK_CELL_PX)
    local gy = floor(py / CHOUKA_MASK_CELL_PX)
    if gx < 0 or gy < 0 or gx >= CHOUKA_MASK_GW or gy >= CHOUKA_MASK_GH then
        return 1                         -- 出图 = 地图边角外海
    end
    local row = ChoukaLandSpans[gy + 1]
    if row == nil then
        return 1
    end
    for i = 1, getn(row), 2 do
        if gx >= row[i] and gx <= row[i + 1] then
            return 0                     -- 落在陆地区间里
        end
    end
    return 1
end

function ChoukaGetPlayerSide(playerName)
    if playerName == nil then
        return 1
    end
    if ChoukaPlayerSideCache[playerName] ~= nil then
        return ChoukaPlayerSideCache[playerName]
    end
    local side = 1
    for j = 1, 4, 1 do
        if EvaluateCondition("PLAYER_HAS_PLAYER_TECH", playerName, ChoukaPlayerSideTech[j]) then
            side = j
        end
    end
    ChoukaPlayerSideCache[playerName] = side
    return side

-- 详见 docs/10-Lua注释存档.md §12_puredraw_replace-2
function ChoukaAddToBatch(objId, playerName, instanceId)
    if ChoukaPendingBatch == nil then
        ChoukaPendingBatch = {}
    end
    if playerName == nil then
        return
    end

    local batch = ChoukaPendingBatch[playerName]
    if batch == nil then
        batch = { ids = {}, hashes = {}, px = {}, py = {}, pz = {},
                  left = CHOUKA_BATCH_FRAMES, age = 0,
                  nativeWater = 0, nativeAir = 0 }
        ChoukaPendingBatch[playerName] = batch
    end

    local n = getn(batch.ids) + 1
    local x = 0
    local y = 0
    local z = 0
    local obj = GetObjectById(objId)
    if ObjectIsAlive(obj) then
        x, y, z = ObjectGetPosition(obj)
    end
    batch.ids[n] = objId
    batch.hashes[n] = instanceId
    batch.px[n] = x
    batch.py[n] = y
    batch.pz[n] = z

    -- ★ 每来一个结果就把窗口重新数满：单抽是 1 个，十连是 10 个，
    --   引擎可能跨帧吐（一次十连不一定全在同一帧），重新数才不会把一批劈成两半。
    --   真正的上限由 CHOUKA_BATCH_MAX_FRAMES 兜住，不会无限拖延。
    batch.left = CHOUKA_BATCH_FRAMES

    -- ★ 水陆判定的第一路信号：引擎在**水面**开箱只会吐海上单位（见 10_puredraw_data 分组表），
    --   比我们自己猜地形可靠得多。
    if instanceId ~= nil then
        local nativeCat = nil
        if ChoukaNativeCatByHash ~= nil then
            nativeCat = ChoukaNativeCatByHash[instanceId]
        end
        if nativeCat == 4 then
            batch.nativeWater = 1
        elseif nativeCat == 3 then
            batch.nativeAir = 1          -- 空军结果不提供水陆信息，交给地形判断
        end
        if ChoukaNativeWaterHash ~= nil and ChoukaNativeWaterHash[instanceId] == 1 then
            batch.nativeWater = 1
        end
        if ChoukaNativeAirHash ~= nil and ChoukaNativeAirHash[instanceId] == 1 then
            batch.nativeAir = 1
        end
    end
end

-- 详见 docs/10-Lua注释存档.md §12_puredraw_replace-3
CHOUKA_GROUP_RADIUS = 60      -- 同箱单位落点相距多少以内算同一群（世界单位）
CHOUKA_PICKER_RADIUS = 100    -- "开箱那个人"的搜索半径（找落点附近最近的自己人）
CHOUKA_DRAW_LOG     = 1       -- 1 = 每次抽卡往日志写一行（定位完改 0，只走日志不刷屏）

function ChoukaDist2(ax, ay, bx, by)
    local dx = ax - bx
    local dy = ay - by
    return dx * dx + dy * dy
end

-- 落点是否可用：读不到、或恰好 (0,0)（地图左下角 = 引擎的"没有坐标"）都算无效。
-- ★ 这就是"家里起重机旁边偶尔多一个结果"的病根：
--   运兵车里的乘客、刚创建还没摆到场上的单位，ObjectGetPosition 会返回 0,0（或在创建事件里
--   ObjectIsAlive 还是假 → ChoukaAddToBatch 只能存 0,0）。这种单位以前会自己单独成一群
--   → 结算时坐标无效 → 退回**起重机位置**生成 → 家里凭空多一个。
function ChoukaPosOk(x, y)
    if x == nil or y == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if x == 0 and y == 0 then
        return 0
    end
    return 1
end

function ChoukaGroupBatch(batch)
    local groups = {}
    local pending = {}          -- 落点读不到的单位（先记着，等有群了再挂进去）
    local n = getn(batch.ids)
    for i = 1, n, 1 do
        local x = batch.px[i]
        local y = batch.py[i]
        local target = nil
        if ChoukaPosOk(x, y) == 1 then
            for k = 1, getn(groups), 1 do
                local cand = groups[k]
                if cand.posOk == 1 and cand.x ~= nil and cand.y ~= nil
                    and ChoukaDist2(x, y, cand.x, cand.y)
                        <= CHOUKA_GROUP_RADIUS * CHOUKA_GROUP_RADIUS then
                    target = cand
                    break
                end
            end
            if target == nil then
                target = { ids = {}, hashes = {}, x = x, y = y, z = batch.pz[i],
                           nativeWater = 0, nativeAir = 0, posOk = 1 }
                tinsert(groups, target)
            end
        else
            -- 落点读不到：并进**最近创建的那一群**（同一只箱子吐出来的"车 + 车里的乘客"），
            -- 不单独算一次结果；一个群都还没有就先攒着
            if getn(groups) > 0 then
                target = groups[getn(groups)]
            else
                tinsert(pending, i)
            end
        end
        if target ~= nil then
            tinsert(target.ids, batch.ids[i])
            tinsert(target.hashes, batch.hashes[i])
        end
    end

    -- 整批都没有可用落点（极端情况）：攒成一群并标 posOk=0，结算时直接作废、不再往家里塞
    if getn(pending) > 0 then
        local host = nil
        if getn(groups) > 0 then
            host = groups[1]
        else
            host = { ids = {}, hashes = {}, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0,
                     nativeWater = 0, nativeAir = 0, posOk = 0 }
            tinsert(groups, host)
        end
        for k = 1, getn(pending), 1 do
            local i = pending[k]
            tinsert(host.ids, batch.ids[i])
            tinsert(host.hashes, batch.hashes[i])
        end
    end

    -- 批级水陆信号对每一群都算数
    for k = 1, getn(groups), 1 do
        if batch.nativeWater == 1 then
            groups[k].nativeWater = 1
        end
        if batch.nativeAir == 1 then
            groups[k].nativeAir = 1
        end
    end
    return groups
end
