-- 真实昵称缓存：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 查到的玩家名（查一次就记住）
ChoukaPlayerNames = ChoukaPlayerNames or {}

-- ① 公屏 / 计分板 / 消息区用：真实昵称；拿不到就退回 $p<N>Name（这些通道会替换）
function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end

-- 所以在玩家死亡时删除旧按钮并重建」）。所以刷新只能"重新 Show 一次"。
-- 万一某个引擎版本 Show 不刷新 desc，把这个开关改 1：会先 SetVisibility 0 再 Show，强制重建。
CHOUKA_BANG_IDENTITY_HIDE_FIRST = CHOUKA_BANG_IDENTITY_HIDE_FIRST or 0

-- 身份表：照赤壁 Bang_159_code:18-30，只取 2~6 人（本图 6 个座位）
ChoukaBangRoleCounts = {
    [2] = { lord = 1, loyalist = 0, rebel = 1, traitor = 0 },
    [3] = { lord = 1, loyalist = 0, rebel = 1, traitor = 1 },
    [4] = { lord = 1, loyalist = 0, rebel = 2, traitor = 1 },
    [5] = { lord = 1, loyalist = 1, rebel = 2, traitor = 1 },
    [6] = { lord = 1, loyalist = 1, rebel = 2, traitor = 2 },
}

-- 固定遍历顺序（只用于"填剩余名额"时保持稳定）
function ChoukaBangRoleOrder()
    return {
        ChoukaT.bangRoleLord,
        ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist,
        ChoukaT.bangRoleRebel,
        ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor,
    }
end

-- ---------------- 小工具 ----------------

-- 0..1 随机数：优先用引擎的 GetRandomNumber，取不到就用线性同余兜底
function ChoukaBangRand01()
    if type(GetRandomNumber) == "function" then
        local r = GetRandomNumber()
        if r ~= nil and r >= 0 and r < 1 then
            return r
        end
    end
    ChoukaBangRandSeed = mod((ChoukaBangRandSeed or 20240501) * 1103515245 + 12345, 2147483648)
    return ChoukaBangRandSeed / 2147483648
end

-- Fisher-Yates 原地洗牌（Lua 4.0：只能 getn / mod，没有 # 和 %）
function ChoukaBangShuffle(list)
    local n = getn(list)
    if n < 2 then
        return list
    end
    local i, j, tmp
    for i = n, 2, -1 do
        j = floor(ChoukaBangRand01() * i) + 1
        if j < 1 then
            j = 1
        end
        if j > i then
            j = i
        end
        tmp = list[i]
        list[i] = list[j]
        list[j] = tmp
    end
    return list
end

-- "Player_3" -> 3（不用 tonumber，避免 4.0 里的版本差异）
function ChoukaBangSeatOfName(playerName)
    if playerName == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local i
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        if playerName == "Player_" .. i then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- 参战座位 = 起重机活着（与 01_income:35 / 02_private_box:551 / 05_dog:54 同一条链）
-- AI 天然包含；空位不出现起重机，所以数量 = 真实参战人数
function ChoukaBangCollectSeats()
    ChoukaBangSeats = {}
    local i, crane
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        crane = GetObjectByScriptName("crane" .. i)
        if ObjectIsAlive(crane) then
            tinsert(ChoukaBangSeats, i)
        end
    end
    ChoukaBangPlayerCount = getn(ChoukaBangSeats)
    return ChoukaBangPlayerCount
end

-- 某个身份在"当前人数"下的名额（给偏好卡片的悬浮提示用）
function ChoukaBangRoleCountOf(role)
    local tbl = ChoukaBangRoleCounts[ChoukaBangPlayerCount]
    if tbl == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord then
        return tbl.lord
    elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist then
        return tbl.loyalist
    elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleRebel then
        return tbl.rebel
    elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor then
        return tbl.traitor
    end
    return 0
end

-- 私发一条给单个玩家（ForPlayer 通道，别人看不到）
function ChoukaBangTellPlayer(playerName, text)
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer(playerName, text, 12)
    end
    _LOG(text .. "   -> " .. playerName)
end

-- ============================================================
-- 顶部「情报」按钮 = 常驻情报面板（悬浮框 desc 里塞三行）
--
--   你的身份：内奸
--   主公：Player_3
--   当前存活：主公、忠臣x1、反贼x2、内奸x1
--
-- 主公之所以能公开：三国杀原本主公就是明牌（赤壁 Bang_159_code:416-420 lorddeathdisplay 里
-- 主公永远带标记）。其余身份仍然暗着，只在阵亡时由 33_bang_win.lua 全图通报。
-- ============================================================

-- 某个座位还活着吗（优先复用 33 号节点的权威实现，没加载就退化成自己的判断）
function ChoukaBangAliveSeat(seat)
    if type(ChoukaBangSeatAlive) == "function" then
        return ChoukaBangSeatAlive(seat)
    end
    if type(GetObjectByScriptName) ~= "function" then
        return 1
    end
    local crane = GetObjectByScriptName("crane" .. seat)
    if crane == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if ObjectIsAlive(crane) then
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

-- 主公是谁（本局一定有一个主公）
function ChoukaBangLordSeat()
    local i, seat
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangSeats), 1 do
        seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        if ChoukaBangRole[seat] == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord then
            return seat
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- 「主公、忠臣x1、反贼x2、内奸x1」——只统计还活着的
function ChoukaBangAliveRoleSummary()
    local i, seat, role
    local lord, loyal, rebel, traitor
    lord = 0
    loyal = 0
    rebel = 0
    traitor = 0
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangSeats), 1 do
        seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        if ChoukaBangAliveSeat(seat) == 1 then
            role = ChoukaBangRole[seat]
            if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord then
                lord = lord + 1
            elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist then
                loyal = loyal + 1
            elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleRebel then
                rebel = rebel + 1
            elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor then
                traitor = traitor + 1
            end
        end
    end

    local out = ""
    if lord > 0 then
        out = ChoukaT.bangRoleLord            -- 主公唯一，不写 x1
    end
    if loyal > 0 then
        out = ChoukaBangJoin(out, format(ChoukaT.bangAliveCount, ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist, loyal))
    end
    if rebel > 0 then
        out = ChoukaBangJoin(out, format(ChoukaT.bangAliveCount, ChoukaT.bangRoleRebel, rebel))
    end
    if traitor > 0 then
        out = ChoukaBangJoin(out, format(ChoukaT.bangAliveCount, ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor, traitor))
    end
    if out == "" then
        out = ChoukaT.bangAliveNone
    end
    return out
end

-- 用「、」把两段拼起来（Lua 4.0 没有 table.concat）
function ChoukaBangJoin(head, tail)
    if head == nil or head == "" then
        return tail
    end
    return head .. ChoukaT.bangAliveSep .. tail
end

-- 悬浮框正文（三~四行，\n 分隔）
function ChoukaBangIdentityDesc(seat)
    local role = ChoukaBangRole[seat]
    if role == nil then
        return ""
    end
    local out = format(ChoukaT.bangInfoSelf, role)
    if ChoukaBangAliveSeat(seat) ~= 1 then
        out = out .. "\n" .. ChoukaT.bangInfoDead
    end
    out = out .. "\n" .. format(ChoukaT.bangInfoAlive, ChoukaBangAliveRoleSummary())
    out = out .. "\n" .. ChoukaT.panelBtnDescBang
    return out
end

-- 底层：把 desc 写进顶部按钮
function ChoukaBangShowIdentityWithDesc(playerName, desc)
    if desc == nil or desc == "" then
        return 0
    end
    if type(exCenterTopBtnShowForPlayer) == "function" then
        exCenterTopBtnShowForPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_BANG_BTN_IDENTITY,
            CHOUKA_BANG_BTN_ICON, desc)
    elseif type(exCenterTopBtnShow) == "function" then
        exCenterTopBtnShow(CHOUKA_BANG_BTN_IDENTITY, CHOUKA_BANG_BTN_ICON, desc)
    else
        return 0
    end
    if type(exCenterTopBtnSetEnableForPlayer) == "function" then
        exCenterTopBtnSetEnableForPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_BANG_BTN_IDENTITY, 1)
    end
    return 1
end

-- 无条件重刷（开局头 30 秒用，覆盖 16_buttons 建整排按钮那一刻）
function ChoukaBangForceIdentity(playerName, seat)
    local desc = ChoukaBangIdentityDesc(seat)
    if desc == "" then
        return 0
    end
    ChoukaBangIdentitySig[playerName] = desc
    return ChoukaBangShowIdentityWithDesc(playerName, desc)
end

-- 内容变了才重建（有人阵亡 / 主公变化 / 存活构成变化）
function ChoukaBangRefreshIdentity(playerName, seat)
    local desc = ChoukaBangIdentityDesc(seat)
    if desc == "" then
        return 0
    end
    if ChoukaBangIdentitySig[playerName] == desc then
        return 0
    end
    ChoukaBangIdentitySig[playerName] = desc
    if CHOUKA_BANG_IDENTITY_HIDE_FIRST == 1 then
        if type(exCenterTopBtnSetVisibilityForPlayer) == "function" then
            exCenterTopBtnSetVisibilityForPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_BANG_BTN_IDENTITY, 0)
        end
    end
    return ChoukaBangShowIdentityWithDesc(playerName, desc)
end

-- 老名字保留（外面还有调用点），语义 = 无条件重刷
function ChoukaBangShowIdentityButton(playerName, seat)
    return ChoukaBangForceIdentity(playerName, seat)
end

function ChoukaBangPublishIdentities()
    local i, seat, role, name
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangSeats), 1 do
        seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        role = ChoukaBangRole[seat]
        if role ~= nil then
            name = "Player_" .. seat
            ChoukaBangTellPlayer(name, format(ChoukaT.bangYourRole, role))
            ChoukaBangForceIdentity(name, seat)
        end
    end

    -- ★ 赤壁同款：给主公在右上角计分板那一行打上【主公】标记
    --   （记分板 / 公屏 / 消息区都会替换 $p<N>Name，所以这里能看到真实名字；
    --     而顶部悬浮框 desc 不替换，这是"主公叫什么"最可靠的展示位置）
    ChoukaBangMarkLordOnBoard()
end

-- 在计分板上标出主公（只做一次，20_hud 的每秒刷新只动第 2 列，不会覆盖第 1 列）
function ChoukaBangMarkLordOnBoard()
    if ChoukaBangLordMarked == 1 then
        return 1
    end
    if type(exScoreBoardSetText) ~= "function" then
        _LOG("三国杀：没有 exScoreBoardSetText，主公标记跳过")
        ChoukaBangLordMarked = 1
        return 0
    end
    local lord = ChoukaBangLordSeat()
    if lord == nil then
        return 0
    end
    exScoreBoardSetText(format(ChoukaT.bangBoardLordMark, ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(lord)), lord, 1)
    ChoukaBangLordMarked = 1
    _LOG("三国杀：计分板第 " .. lord .. " 行已标出主公")
    return 1
end

-- ============================================================
-- 发身份：偏好优先 → 剩余名额随机补齐
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaBangAssignRoles()
    local count = ChoukaBangCollectSeats()

    -- 人数不足 2（或表里没有这一档）：降级为默认玩法，别让整局卡死
    if count < 2 or ChoukaBangRoleCounts[count] == nil then
        CHOUKA_MODE = 0
        ChoukaBangPrefDone = 1
        ChoukaBangRolesReady = 1
        ChoukaBangDegraded = 1
        ChoukaAlert(ChoukaT.bangDegrade)
        return 0
    end

    local tbl = ChoukaBangRoleCounts[count]
    local quota = {}
    quota[ChoukaT.bangRoleLord]     = tbl.lord
    quota[ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist] = tbl.loyalist
    quota[ChoukaT.bangRoleRebel]    = tbl.rebel
    quota[ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor]  = tbl.traitor

    -- 座位池洗牌：让"同样的偏好"在多人竞争时也是公平的
    local pool = {}
    local i, k
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        tinsert(pool, ChoukaBangSeats[i])
    end
    ChoukaBangShuffle(pool)

    ChoukaBangRole = {}
    local taken = {}

    -- 第一轮：有偏好且该身份名额还够 → 直接给
    local seat, name, want
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        seat = pool[i]
        name = "Player_" .. seat
        want = ChoukaBangPref[name]
        if want ~= nil and want ~= ChoukaT.bangRoleAbstain then
            if quota[want] ~= nil and quota[want] > 0 then
                ChoukaBangRole[seat] = want
                quota[want] = quota[want] - 1
                taken[seat] = 1
            end
        end
    end

    -- 第二轮：把剩下的名额拍成一个数组、洗牌，依次发给没身份的人
    local remain = {}
    local order = ChoukaBangRoleOrder()
    local q, rn, r
    for r = 1, getn(order), 1 do
        rn = order[r]
        q = quota[rn]
        if q ~= nil and q > 0 then
            for k = 1, q, 1 do
                tinsert(remain, rn)
            end
        end
    end
    ChoukaBangShuffle(remain)

    local idx = 1
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        seat = pool[i]
        if taken[seat] ~= 1 then
            if remain[idx] ~= nil then
                ChoukaBangRole[seat] = remain[idx]
                idx = idx + 1
            end
            taken[seat] = 1
        end
    end

    -- 找主公座位（身份表保证主公恰好 1 个）
    ChoukaBangLordIndex = nil
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        if ChoukaBangRole[seat] == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord then
            ChoukaBangLordIndex = seat
        end
    end

    -- 私发身份 + 顶部情报按钮
    ChoukaBangPublishIdentities()

    ChoukaBangRolesReady = 1
    ChoukaBangStage = 2
    ChoukaBangIdentityTick = 0

    -- 关系在这里设不了（31 号节点可能还没跑到），交给 31 的每次求值补设
    if type(ChoukaBangApplyInitialRelations) == "function" then
        if ChoukaBangApplyInitialRelations() == 1 then
            ChoukaBangRelationsApplied = 1
        end
    end

    ChoukaAlert(format(ChoukaT.bangAssigned, count,
        tbl.lord, tbl.loyalist, tbl.rebel, tbl.traitor))
    if ChoukaBangLordIndex ~= nil then
        _LOG("三国杀：主公 = Player_" .. ChoukaBangLordIndex)
    end

    local seatList = ""
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        if seatList == "" then
            seatList = "Player_" .. seat .. "=" .. (ChoukaBangRole[seat] or "?")
        else
            seatList = seatList .. "," .. "Player_" .. seat .. "=" .. (ChoukaBangRole[seat] or "?")
        end
    end
    _LOG("三国杀：身份分布 = " .. seatList)
    return 1
end

-- ============================================================
-- 每次求值
-- ============================================================

if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 then
    return
end

-- ① 偏好投票结束 → 发身份（等 32 号节点把 ChoukaBangPrefDone 置 1）
if ChoukaBangPrefDone == 1 and ChoukaBangRolesReady ~= 1 then
    ChoukaBangAssignRoles()
end

-- ② 顶部情报按钮 = 常驻情报面板
--    头 30 秒：无条件重刷（16_buttons 的 exCenterTopBtnsChangeVisibilityForPlayer 可能把整排按钮重置掉）
--    之后：只在"面板内容变了"时重建（有人阵亡 → 存活构成变化）
--          顶部按钮没有 Desc setter，所以"变一次重建一次"，不每秒硬刷
if ChoukaBangRolesReady == 1 then
    local i, seat, role
    if ChoukaBangIdentityTick < CHOUKA_BANG_IDENTITY_TICK_MAX then
        ChoukaBangIdentityTick = ChoukaBangIdentityTick + 1
        for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangSeats), 1 do
            seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
            if ChoukaBangRole[seat] ~= nil then
                ChoukaBangForceIdentity("Player_" .. seat, seat)
            end
        end
    else
        for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangSeats), 1 do
            seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
            if ChoukaBangRole[seat] ~= nil then
                ChoukaBangRefreshIdentity("Player_" .. seat, seat)
            end
        end
    end
end

function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then

    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]

    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then

-- ============================================================
-- 三国杀 · 结盟子系统（严格身份阵营）  详见 docs/11-三国杀模式方案.md §7
-- 底层只有一句 ExecuteAction("PLAYER_RELATES_PLAYER", 我, 他, 关系)：
--   单向 = 1 次；双向 = 正反各 1 次（照赤壁 AllegianceModule，源码见 Bang_30_code）
-- ============================================================

ChoukaMarkNodeReady("三国杀-结盟")

CHOUKA_BANG_REL_FRIEND  = "Friend"
CHOUKA_BANG_REL_ENEMY   = "Enemy"
CHOUKA_BANG_REL_NEUTRAL = "Neutral"

ChoukaBangRelationsApplied = ChoukaBangRelationsApplied or 0

-- 单向：只改 from 对 to 的态度（to 对 from 不变）
function ChoukaBangRelateOne(fromName, toName, rel)
    if fromName == nil or toName == nil or rel == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if fromName == toName then
        return 0
    end
    if type(ExecuteAction) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end
    ExecuteAction("PLAYER_RELATES_PLAYER", fromName, toName, rel)
    return 1
end

-- 双向：正反各设一次
function ChoukaBangRelateBoth(nameA, nameB, rel)
    if nameA == nil or nameB == nil or rel == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if nameA == nameB then
        return 0
    end
    ChoukaBangRelateOne(nameA, nameB, rel)
    ChoukaBangRelateOne(nameB, nameA, rel)
    return 1
end

-- 读关系：0 = 敌人 / 1 = 中立 / 2 = 友军（读不到返回 nil）
function ChoukaBangGetRel(nameA, nameB)
    if type(exPlayerGetRelationShip) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    return exPlayerGetRelationShip(nameA, nameB)
end

function ChoukaBangIsLordSide(role)
    if role == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord or role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist then
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

-- ============================================================
-- 初始关系（严格阵营）
--   分四遍写、后一遍覆盖前一遍，这样和遍历顺序无关：
--     ① 全员互为敌人  ② 主忠之间双向友军
--     ③ 内奸 → 主公 单向友军（唯一的不对称）  ④ 主公 ↔ PlyrCreeps 双向友军
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaBangApplyInitialRelations()
    if ChoukaBangSeats == nil or ChoukaBangRole == nil then
        return 0
    end
    local total = getn(ChoukaBangSeats)
    if total < 2 then
        return 0
    end

    local i, k, seatA, seatB, nameA, nameB, roleA, roleB

    -- ① 默认全员敌对（反贼之间也是敌人：身份是暗的，得靠"认亲"才成为盟友）
    for i = 1, total, 1 do
        seatA = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        nameA = "Player_" .. seatA
        for k = i + 1, total, 1 do
            seatB = ChoukaBangSeats[k]
            nameB = "Player_" .. seatB
            ChoukaBangRelateBoth(nameA, nameB, CHOUKA_BANG_REL_ENEMY)
        end
    end

    -- ② 主公与忠臣之间天然友军
    for i = 1, total, 1 do
        seatA = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        roleA = ChoukaBangRole[seatA]
        if ChoukaBangIsLordSide(roleA) == 1 then
            nameA = "Player_" .. seatA
            for k = i + 1, total, 1 do
                seatB = ChoukaBangSeats[k]
                roleB = ChoukaBangRole[seatB]
                if ChoukaBangIsLordSide(roleB) == 1 then
                    nameB = "Player_" .. seatB
                    ChoukaBangRelateBoth(nameA, nameB, CHOUKA_BANG_REL_FRIEND)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- ③ 内奸 → 主公 单向友军：内奸打不了主公，主公能打内奸
    if ChoukaBangLordIndex ~= nil then
        nameA = "Player_" .. ChoukaBangLordIndex
        for i = 1, total, 1 do
            seatB = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
            if ChoukaBangRole[seatB] == ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor then
                nameB = "Player_" .. seatB
                ChoukaBangRelateOne(nameB, nameA, CHOUKA_BANG_REL_FRIEND)
            end
        end
    end

    -- ④ 主公 ↔ 中立怪 PlyrCreeps 双向友军（照赤壁 Bang_160_code:797-801）
    if ChoukaBangLordIndex ~= nil then
        nameA = "Player_" .. ChoukaBangLordIndex
        ChoukaBangRelateBoth(nameA, "PlyrCreeps", CHOUKA_BANG_REL_FRIEND)
    end

    _LOG("三国杀：初始关系已设（" .. total .. " 人，主公=Player_" ..
         (ChoukaBangLordIndex or 0) .. "）")
    return 1
end

-- ============================================================
-- 每次求值：只负责在关系模块加载晚于身份分配时补设一次
-- ============================================================

if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 then
    return
end

if ChoukaBangRolesReady == 1 and ChoukaBangRelationsApplied ~= 1 then
    if ChoukaBangApplyInitialRelations() == 1 then
        ChoukaBangRelationsApplied = 1
    end
end

function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end

-- ============================================================
-- 三国杀 · 身份偏好（复用原生选择页 + 文字选项）
-- 详见 docs/11-三国杀模式方案.md §5
--
-- 作者 2026-10 定案：**不要自绘卡片和图标**，直接用游戏原生的
-- `exShowCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer`（和房主配置页、交易市场同一个控件），
-- 一屏 5 个文字选项：
--     主公（名额 1） / 忠臣（名额 1） / 反贼（名额 2） / 内奸（名额 1） / 弃权（随机分配）
--
-- 交互 = 一步到位：点哪个就是哪个（原生选择页点完自动关），没有"再点确认"那一步。
--
-- ★★ 关键教训（2026-10 实测）：**只给真人弹面板，绝不能给 AI 座位弹。**
--    第一版给全部 6 个座位都弹了，结果真人还没选，自己那份面板就被"别人"关掉了。
--    原因：按钮选择对话框在引擎里只有一个"当前显示位"，
--      · 给另一个座位 Show 一次，就会把屏幕上正开着的那份顶掉；
--      · 任何一个座位应答，`exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer` 收掉的也是同一份。
--    所以 AI 座位一律不弹 —— 它们的身份直接随机（正好是它们本来的行为）。
-- ============================================================

ChoukaMarkNodeReady("三国杀-偏好")

-- ---------------- 常量 ----------------

-- 原生选择页 id。已占用：700+序号=交易市场(701~706)、710+序号=防御塔(711~716)、
--                      810=开局公告长文本、811=房主配置页
CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_DIALOG       = 730

CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_SECONDS      = CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_SECONDS or 180

-- ★ 提前收尾：只要真人选过，再静默这么多秒就结束
--   （现在是"真人一选就立刻收尾"，这条只在将来多真人时兜底）
CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_GRACE        = CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_GRACE or 15

-- 还没选的话，每隔这么多秒重新弹一次面板（玩家把面板点叉了也能再拿到）
CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_REOPEN_EVERY = CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_REOPEN_EVERY or 30

-- ---------------- 状态（全局：Lua 桥的闭包拿不到外层 local） ----------------

ChoukaBangPref              = ChoukaBangPref or {}         -- playerName -> 想要的身份
ChoukaBangReady             = ChoukaBangReady or {}        -- playerName -> 1 已选过
ChoukaBangPrefPlayers       = ChoukaBangPrefPlayers or {}  -- 真正弹了面板的座位（= 真人座位）
ChoukaBangPrefHumanPlayers  = ChoukaBangPrefHumanPlayers or {}
ChoukaBangPrefTick          = ChoukaBangPrefTick or 0
ChoukaBangPrefLastReadyTick = ChoukaBangPrefLastReadyTick or 0
ChoukaBangPrefUiCreated     = ChoukaBangPrefUiCreated or {}
ChoukaBangPrefNoApiWarned   = ChoukaBangPrefNoApiWarned or 0

-- 面板上的 5 个选项（文案来自 ChoukaT，因此身份名和逻辑值天然一致）
ChoukaBangPrefRolesCache = ChoukaBangPrefRolesCache or {
    ChoukaT.bangRoleLord,
    ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist,
    ChoukaT.bangRoleRebel,
    ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor,
    ChoukaT.bangRoleAbstain,
}

function ChoukaBangPrefRoles()
    return ChoukaBangPrefRolesCache
end

-- 这个身份在"当前人数"下的名额（实现在 30 号节点）
function ChoukaBangPrefQuotaOf(role)
    if type(ChoukaBangRoleCountOf) == "function" then
        return ChoukaBangRoleCountOf(role)
    end
    return 0
end

-- ============================================================
-- 找出"该弹面板的座位"
--
-- 本图唯一可靠的真人接口是 `ObjectPlayerScriptName("<1st Human Player>")`
-- （03_start.lua:105-106 就是这么认出房主的 —— 房主配置页确实弹给了真人，
--   证明这条路是通的）。`EvaluateCondition(..., "Human")` 在本图返回空，
-- 那正是第一版"零真人 → 偏好被静默跳过"的真凶，别再用它。
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaBangPrefPushSeat(list, name)
    if name == nil or name == "" then
        return
    end
    local i
    for i = 1, getn(list), 1 do
        if list[i] == name then
            return
        end
    end
    tinsert(list, name)
end

function ChoukaBangPrefCollectSeats()
    local out = {}

    -- ① 第一个真人玩家
    if type(ObjectPlayerScriptName) == "function" then
        ChoukaBangPrefPushSeat(out, ObjectPlayerScriptName("<1st Human Player>"))
    end

    -- ② 房主（03_start 认出来的那个；和上面重复会自动去重）
    ChoukaBangPrefPushSeat(out, ChoukaStartHost)

    -- ③ 全都没认出来：兜底给 Player_1（03_start.lua:112 的房主兜底值也是它）
    if getn(out) == 0 then
        tinsert(out, "Player_1")
        _LOG("三国杀：偏好认不出真人，兜底只弹给 Player_1")
    end

    return out
end

-- 原生选择页
-- ============================================================

-- 5 个文字选项：「主公（名额 1）」…
function ChoukaBangPrefOptions()
    local roles = ChoukaBangPrefRoles()
    local out = {}
    local i, role
    for i = 1, getn(roles), 1 do
        role = roles[i]
        if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleAbstain then
            tinsert(out, ChoukaT.bangPrefAbstain)
        else
            tinsert(out, format(ChoukaT.bangPrefOption, role, ChoukaBangPrefQuotaOf(role)))
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- 参数顺序照 03_start.lua 的 ChoukaStartShowDialog：
--   固定 10 参 = 玩家名 + 面板id + 标题 + 最多 7 个选项，不足补空串
function ChoukaBangPrefShowFor(playerName)
    if playerName == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if type(exShowCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer) ~= "function" then
        if ChoukaBangPrefNoApiWarned ~= 1 then
            ChoukaBangPrefNoApiWarned = 1
            ChoukaAlert(ChoukaT.bangPrefNoApi)
            _LOG("三国杀：没有 exShowCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer，身份偏好面板开不出来，本局随机")
        end
        return 0
    end

    local args = { playerName, CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_DIALOG, ChoukaT.bangPrefTitle }
    local choices = ChoukaBangPrefOptions()
    local i
    for i = 1, getn(choices), 1 do
        tinsert(args, choices[i])
    end
    while getn(args) < 10 do
        tinsert(args, "")
    end
    call(exShowCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer, args)

    ChoukaBangPrefUiCreated[playerName] = 1
    return 1
end

function ChoukaBangPrefHideFor(playerName)
    if playerName == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if type(exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer) == "function" then
        exHideCustomBtnChoiceDialogForPlayer(playerName)
    end
    return 1
end

-- ============================================================
-- 选择页回调（由 16_buttons.lua 的 onUserBtnChoiceDialogEvent 分发进来）
--   签名照 03_start.lua 的 ChoukaChoice_start：(playerName, btnIndex, dialogId)
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaChoice_bangPref(playerName, btnIndex, dialogId)
    if dialogId ~= CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_DIALOG then
        return 0
    end

    -- 已经过了投票阶段（或不是三国杀局）：把面板收掉就行
    if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 or ChoukaBangStage ~= 1 or ChoukaBangPrefDone == 1 then
        ChoukaBangPrefHideFor(playerName)
        return 1
    end
    if playerName == nil or btnIndex == nil then
        return 1
    end

    local roles = ChoukaBangPrefRoles()
    if btnIndex < 1 or btnIndex > getn(roles) then
        return 1
    end

    local role = roles[btnIndex]
    ChoukaBangPref[playerName] = role
    ChoukaBangReady[playerName] = 1
    ChoukaBangPrefLastReadyTick = ChoukaBangPrefTick or 0
    ChoukaBangPrefHideFor(playerName)

    _LOG("三国杀：偏好 " .. playerName .. " 选了 " .. role .. "（立刻进入发身份）")
    if type(ChoukaBangTellPlayer) == "function" then
        ChoukaBangTellPlayer(playerName, format(ChoukaT.bangPrefYouPicked, role))
    end
    return 1
end

function ChoukaBangAllReady()
    local n = getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers)
    if n == 0 then
        return 1
    end
    local i
    for i = 1, n, 1 do
        if ChoukaBangReady[ChoukaBangPrefPlayers[i]] ~= 1 then
            return 0
        end
    end
    return 1
end

function ChoukaBangPrefReadyCount()
    local i, c
    c = 0
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers), 1 do
        if ChoukaBangReady[ChoukaBangPrefPlayers[i]] == 1 then
            c = c + 1
        end
    end
    return c
end

-- 由 03_start.lua 在房主确认开局且玩法=三国杀时调用；节点体里也有一道兜底自启
function ChoukaBangBeginPreference()
    if ChoukaBangPrefDone == 1 then
        _LOG("三国杀：偏好跳过（PrefDone 已经是 1）")
        return 0
    end
    if ChoukaBangStage ~= 0 and ChoukaBangStage ~= 1 then
        _LOG("三国杀：偏好跳过（Stage=" .. (ChoukaBangStage or -1) .. "，只接受 0/1）")
        return 0
    end
    if ChoukaBangStage == 1 and getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers) > 0 then
        -- 已经在进行中：幂等，不重复弹面板
        return 1
    end

    ChoukaBangStage = 1
    ChoukaBangPrefTick = 0
    ChoukaBangPrefLastReadyTick = 0
    ChoukaBangPref = {}
    ChoukaBangReady = {}
    ChoukaBangPrefUiCreated = {}

    if type(ChoukaBangCollectSeats) == "function" then
        ChoukaBangCollectSeats()
    end

    -- ★ 只给真人座位弹面板（原因见文件头）。AI 座位不弹，身份直接随机。
    ChoukaBangPrefPlayers = ChoukaBangPrefCollectSeats()
    ChoukaBangPrefHumanPlayers = ChoukaBangPrefPlayers

    local i, name
    if getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers) == 0 then
        ChoukaAlert(ChoukaT.bangPrefNoApi)
        _LOG("三国杀：偏好跳过（没有真人座位可弹）")
        ChoukaBangPrefDone = 1
        return 1
    end

    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers), 1 do
        ChoukaBangPrefShowFor(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers[i])
    end

    -- 面板没弹出来（接口缺失）→ 别干等 180 秒，直接随机
    if getn(ChoukaBangPrefUiCreated) == 0 then
        _LOG("三国杀：偏好面板没弹出来，直接随机身份（不等超时）")
        ChoukaBangPrefPlayers = {}
        ChoukaBangPrefDone = 1
        return 1
    end

    ChoukaAlert(format(ChoukaT.bangPrefBegin, CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_SECONDS))
    _LOG("三国杀：身份偏好面板已弹 —— 只弹给真人座位 " ..
         getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers) .. " 个（" ..
         ChoukaBangPrefPlayers[1] .. "）；参战座位 " .. getn(ChoukaBangSeats) ..
         " 个，其余随机；最多等 " .. CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_SECONDS .. " 秒")
    return 1
end

function ChoukaBangPrefFinish(timedOut)
    if ChoukaBangPrefDone == 1 then
        return 0
    end

    local i, name
    if timedOut == 1 then
        for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers), 1 do
            name = ChoukaBangPrefPlayers[i]
            if ChoukaBangPref[name] == nil then
                ChoukaBangPref[name] = ChoukaT.bangRoleAbstain
            end
            ChoukaBangReady[name] = 1
        end
        ChoukaAlert(ChoukaT.bangPrefTimeout)
    end

    -- 收面板（没选的人面板还开着，一起收掉）
    for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers), 1 do
        ChoukaBangPrefHideFor(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers[i])
    end

    ChoukaBangPrefDone = 1
    _LOG("三国杀：身份偏好结束（timedOut=" .. (timedOut or 0) .. "）")
    return 1
end

function ChoukaBangPrefTickOnce()
    ChoukaBangPrefTick = ChoukaBangPrefTick + 1

    -- ① 该弹的座位都选过了 → 立刻收尾（单真人局：选完马上开局）
    if ChoukaBangAllReady() == 1 then
        ChoukaBangPrefFinish(0)
        return
    end

    -- ② 有人选过、且已静默 GRACE 秒 → 收尾（留给将来多个真人的场景兜底）
    if ChoukaBangPrefReadyCount() > 0 then
        if (ChoukaBangPrefTick - (ChoukaBangPrefLastReadyTick or 0)) >= CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_GRACE then
            _LOG("三国杀：选完静默 " .. CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_GRACE .. " 秒，偏好收尾")
            ChoukaBangPrefFinish(0)
            return
        end
    end

    -- ③ 硬超时
    if ChoukaBangPrefTick >= CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_SECONDS then
        ChoukaBangPrefFinish(1)
        return
    end

    -- ④ 没选的座位定期重弹（玩家把面板点叉了也能再拿到）
    if mod(ChoukaBangPrefTick, CHOUKA_BANG_PREF_REOPEN_EVERY) == 0 then
        local i, name
        for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangPrefPlayers), 1 do
            name = ChoukaBangPrefPlayers[i]
            if ChoukaBangReady[name] ~= 1 then
                ChoukaBangPrefShowFor(name)
            end
        end
    end
end

--   偏好阶段已经改用原生选择页，这里只剩「情报按钮」一个分支。
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaBangOnBtn(playerName, btnIndex)
    if btnIndex == nil or playerName == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if btnIndex ~= CHOUKA_BANG_BTN_IDENTITY then
        return 0
    end
    if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 or ChoukaBangRolesReady ~= 1 then
        return 0
    end

    local seat = nil
    if type(ChoukaBangSeatOfName) == "function" then
        seat = ChoukaBangSeatOfName(playerName)
    end
    if seat == nil or ChoukaBangRole[seat] == nil then
        return 0
    end

    -- 点一下只开面板，**不再私发"你的身份是：X"**（面板里信息已经完整，作者要求去掉这条播报）；
    -- 悬浮框 desc 仍然重刷一次，保证鼠标划上去看到的是最新情报。
    if type(ChoukaBangForceIdentity) == "function" then
        ChoukaBangForceIdentity(playerName, seat)
    end
    -- 三国杀模式下，顶部身份按钮（index 5，间谍图标）就是**身份面板**的入口：
    -- 用 Toggle 与官渡 BangUiToggle 一致（面板已开时再点 = 关闭），面板本体见 35_ally_panel.lua
    if type(ChoukaPanelToggle) == "function" then
        ChoukaPanelToggle(seat)
    end
    return 1
end

if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 then

end

--   无脑 tinsert 会让处理函数表每秒变长，所以用标志位卡住（照 03_start.lua）

        ChoukaBangPrefTickOnce()
    end
end

function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)

--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)

    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then

    local n = getn(ChoukaBangSeats)
    local i, seat, role
    for i = 1, n, 1 do

        role = ChoukaBangRole[seat]
        if role ~= nil and ChoukaBangEliminated[seat] ~= 1 then
            if ChoukaBangSeatAlive(seat) ~= 1 then

                -- ★ 全图通报（日志 + 左下消息区 + 公屏三路，见 00_core/00_alert.lua 的 ChoukaAlertFor）

        end
    end
    return 1

-- 胜负判定
--   ★ 与赤壁的两处差异：
--     ① 删掉「主公失去控制」那段（本图没有 PW<主公> 这个具名对象，起重机只会被摧毁）
--     ② 内奸判定从 alive_count==1 and traitor==1
--        改成 alive_count == traitor_count（场上只剩内奸），
--        这样 6 人局两个内奸不会在主公刚死时被提前判和
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaBangCheckGameEnd()
    local n = getn(ChoukaBangSeats)
    if n < 2 then
        return nil
    end

    local alive_count = 0
    local lord_alive = 0
    local loyalist_alive = 0
    local rebel_alive = 0
    local traitor_count = 0

    local i, seat, role
    for i = 1, n, 1 do
        seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        if ChoukaBangSeatAlive(seat) == 1 then
            alive_count = alive_count + 1
            role = ChoukaBangRole[seat]
            if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord then
                lord_alive = 1
            elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist then
                loyalist_alive = 1
            elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleRebel then
                rebel_alive = 1
            elseif role == ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor then
                traitor_count = traitor_count + 1
            end
        end
    end

    if lord_alive == 0 then
        -- 主公阵亡后，还有反贼活着 → 反贼胜
        if rebel_alive == 1 then
            return CHOUKA_BANG_RES_REBEL
        end
        -- 内奸还在 → 只有"场上只剩内奸"才判内奸胜，否则还要先清掉忠臣
        if traitor_count >= 1 then
            if alive_count == traitor_count then
                return CHOUKA_BANG_RES_TRAITOR
            end
            return nil
        end
        -- 反贼与内奸都没了，主公也死了 → 无人可胜
        return CHOUKA_BANG_RES_NONE
    elseif rebel_alive == 0 and traitor_count == 0 then
        return CHOUKA_BANG_RES_LORD
    end

    return nil
end

-- ============================================================
-- 结算
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaBangSeatIsWinner(seat, code)
    local role = ChoukaBangRole[seat]
    if role == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if code == CHOUKA_BANG_RES_REBEL then
        if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleRebel then
            return 1
        end
        return 0
    elseif code == CHOUKA_BANG_RES_TRAITOR then
        if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleTraitor then
            return 1
        end
        return 0
    elseif code == CHOUKA_BANG_RES_LORD then
        if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord or role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLoyalist then
            return 1
        end
        return 0
    end
    return 0
end

function ChoukaBangEndGame(code)
    if CHOUKA_BANG_ENDED == 1 then
        return 0
    end
    CHOUKA_BANG_ENDED = 1
    ChoukaBangStage = 3

    local i, k, seat, otherName, otherSeat
    local winners = {}
    local n = getn(ChoukaBangSeats)

    for i = 1, n, 1 do
        seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        if ChoukaBangSeatIsWinner(seat, code) == 1 then
            tinsert(winners, seat)
        end
    end

    -- ① 赢家之间互相友军（照赤壁 BangAllyWinners，Bang_162_code:130）
    if getn(winners) >= 2 then
        for i = 1, getn(winners), 1 do
            for k = i + 1, getn(winners), 1 do
                if type(ChoukaBangRelateBoth) == "function" then
                    ChoukaBangRelateBoth("Player_" .. winners[i],
                        "Player_" .. winners[k], CHOUKA_BANG_REL_FRIEND)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- ② 输家清场（照赤壁 BangKillLosers 的 PLAYER_KILL）
    if getn(winners) > 0 and type(ExecuteAction) == "function" then
        for i = 1, n, 1 do
            seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
            if ChoukaBangSeatIsWinner(seat, code) ~= 1 then
                ExecuteAction("PLAYER_KILL", "Player_" .. seat)
            end
        end
    end

    -- ③ 播报（ChoukaAlert 本身就是"日志 + 消息区 + 公屏"三路输出，见 00_core/00_alert.lua）
    local text = ChoukaBangResultText(code)
    ChoukaAlertFor(format(ChoukaT.bangGameOver, text), 30)

    -- ④ 把最终身份全公开（本局已结束，没有暗将的意义了）
    --   日志逐条留档 + 公屏再发一条"全员身份"总览，这样中途阵亡漏看的也能一次看清。
    local roster = ""
    for i = 1, n, 1 do
        seat = ChoukaBangSeats[i]
        if ChoukaBangRole[seat] ~= nil then
            _LOG("三国杀结算：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. ChoukaBangRole[seat])
            if roster == "" then
                roster = format(ChoukaT.bangRosterItem, ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat), ChoukaBangRole[seat])
            else
                roster = roster .. "  " .. format(ChoukaT.bangRosterItem, ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat), ChoukaBangRole[seat])
            end
        end
    end
    if roster ~= "" then
        ChoukaAlertFor(format(ChoukaT.bangRoster, roster), 30)
    end

    return 1
end

-- ============================================================
-- 每次求值
-- ============================================================

if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 then
    return
end

if ChoukaBangRolesReady ~= 1 then
    return
end

if ChoukaBangStartApplied ~= 1 then
    return
end

if CHOUKA_BANG_ENDED == 1 then
    return
end

ChoukaBangAnnounceEliminations()

local bangResult = ChoukaBangCheckGameEnd()
if bangResult ~= nil then
    ChoukaBangEndGame(bangResult)
end

--   完整来龙去脉见 docs/03 §8「不要去抢通用全局名」；新代码一律用 ChoukaAlert / ChoukaAlertFor。

function ChoukaAlert(msg)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    -- ① 日志（唯一确认可靠的通道，必须第一个调）
    _LOG(msg)
    -- ② 左下消息区

    end
    -- ③ 公屏（全场可见，阵亡通报/占领播报靠它）
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
    end
end

-- 带显示时长的版本（公告类用长一点）
function ChoukaAlertFor(msg, seconds)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    _LOG(msg)
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        if seconds == nil then

        end
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, seconds)

end

-- 真实昵称缓存：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 查到的玩家名（查一次就记住）
ChoukaPlayerNames = ChoukaPlayerNames or {}

-- ① 公屏 / 计分板 / 消息区用：真实昵称；拿不到就退回 $p<N>Name（这些通道会替换）
function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end

-- 玩家颜色 → 纯色贴图（照搬官渡 BangGetPlayerColorIcon：头像就是一块纯色，

ChoukaPlayerColorCode = ChoukaPlayerColorCode or {}

function ChoukaPanelColorCode(seat)
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerColorCode[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        return cached
    end
    local code = 0
    if type(exPlayerGetColor) == "function" then
        local color = exPlayerGetColor(ChoukaPanelName(seat))
        if type(color) == "table" then
            if type(color[1]) == "number" then
                code = color[1]
            end
        end
    end
    ChoukaPlayerColorCode[seat] = code
    return code
end

function ChoukaPanelColorIcon(seat)
    local code = ChoukaPanelColorCode(seat)
    if code == 50 then
        if ChoukaUiColorBlue ~= nil then return ChoukaUiColorBlue end
    elseif code == 230 then
        if ChoukaUiColorRed ~= nil then return ChoukaUiColorRed end
    elseif code == 237 then
        if ChoukaUiColorYellow ~= nil then return ChoukaUiColorYellow end
    elseif code == 225 then
        if ChoukaUiColorOrange ~= nil then return ChoukaUiColorOrange end
    elseif code == 20 then
        if ChoukaUiColorGreen ~= nil then return ChoukaUiColorGreen end
    elseif code == 125 then
        if ChoukaUiColorPurple ~= nil then return ChoukaUiColorPurple end
    elseif code == 102 then
        if ChoukaUiColorCyan ~= nil then return ChoukaUiColorCyan end
    end
    return ChoukaPanelIconUnknown()
end

function ChoukaPanelSeatOf(playerName)
    if type(playerName) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(strsub(playerName, 8))
end

function ChoukaPanelName(seat)
    return "Player_" .. seat
end

-- 这个座位还在打吗（起重机 = 本图的"水晶"）
function ChoukaPanelSeatAlive(seat)
    if type(ChoukaBangSeatAlive) == "function" then
        if ChoukaBangSeatAlive(seat) == 1 then
            return 1
        end
        return 0
    end
    if type(GetObjectByScriptName) ~= "function" then
        return 1
    end
    local crane = GetObjectByScriptName("crane" .. seat)
    if crane == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if type(ObjectIsAlive) == "function" then
        if ObjectIsAlive(crane) then
            return 1
        end
        return 0
    end
    return 1
end

-- 面板里列出哪些座位：三国杀用参战座位，否则用"有起重机的座位"
function ChoukaPanelCollectSeats()
    local out = {}
    local i
    if CHOUKA_MODE == 1 and type(ChoukaBangSeats) == "table" and getn(ChoukaBangSeats) > 0 then
        for i = 1, getn(ChoukaBangSeats), 1 do
            tinsert(out, ChoukaBangSeats[i])
        end
        return out
    end
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        if type(GetObjectByScriptName) ~= "function" then
            tinsert(out, i)
        else
            if GetObjectByScriptName("crane" .. i) ~= nil then
                tinsert(out, i)
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- 身份文字：**可见性规则与悬浮框一致**（docs/11 §6③），绝不能把别人的身份直接写出来。
--   能看见的只有三种：自己的身份 / 主公（公开）/ 已阵亡者的身份（阵亡即公开）。
function ChoukaPanelRoleText(viewerSeat, seat)
    if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 then
        return nil
    end
    if type(ChoukaBangRole) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end
    local role = ChoukaBangRole[seat]
    if role == nil or role == ChoukaT.bangRoleAbstain then
        return nil
    end
    local visible = nil
    if seat == viewerSeat then
        visible = 1
    else
        if role == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord then
            visible = 1
        end
        if ChoukaPanelSeatAlive(seat) ~= 1 then
            visible = 1
        end
    end
    if visible ~= 1 then
        return nil
    end
    return format(ChoukaT.panelRole, role)
end

-- 关系短词（面板格子只有 ~118 px，长句会被引擎强制换行，所以全部压到 3~4 个字）
function ChoukaPanelRelationShort(viewerSeat, targetSeat)
    if targetSeat == viewerSeat then
        return ChoukaT.panelShortSelf
    end
    if ChoukaPanelSeatAlive(targetSeat) ~= 1 then
        return ChoukaT.panelShortDead
    end
    local vName = ChoukaPanelName(viewerSeat)
    local tName = ChoukaPanelName(targetSeat)
    local mine, theirs
    mine = 0
    theirs = 0
    if ChoukaAllyFrom[vName] ~= nil then
        if ChoukaAllyFrom[vName][tName] == 1 then
            mine = 1
        end
    end
    if ChoukaAllyFrom[tName] ~= nil then
        if ChoukaAllyFrom[tName][vName] == 1 then
            theirs = 1
        end
    end
    if mine == 1 and theirs == 1 then
        return ChoukaT.panelShortBoth
    end
    if mine == 1 then
        return ChoukaT.panelShortMine
    end
    if theirs == 1 then
        return ChoukaT.panelShortTheirs
    end
    return ChoukaT.panelShortNone
end


-- 面板格子里的名字：真名太长会换行，超过 6 个字截断；没有真名就用 $p<N>Name 占位符
-- （自定义文字通道会替换它，所以显示出来仍是真名；公屏那份兜底已按作者要求删掉）。
function ChoukaPanelPanelName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    if strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        return name
    end
    if strlen(name) > 6 then
        return strsub(name, 1, 6) .. "…"
    end
    return name
end


-- 面板格子：第一行名字（后面补全角空格把文字盒子撑开，防止折行），
-- 三国杀里主公多一行"主公"（官渡同款，方便一眼认出并优先选择），最后一行是关系状态。
function ChoukaPanelPlayerLabel(viewerSeat, targetSeat)
    local out
    out = ChoukaPanelPanelName(targetSeat) .. CHOUKA_PANEL_PAD
    if CHOUKA_MODE == 1 and type(ChoukaBangRole) == "table" then
        if ChoukaBangRole[targetSeat] == ChoukaT.bangRoleLord then
            out = out .. "\n" .. ChoukaT.panelLordMark
        end
    end
    out = out .. "\n" .. ChoukaPanelRelationShort(viewerSeat, targetSeat)
    return out
end


-- 头像贴图：玩家所属颜色（官渡玩家列表页就是这么渲染的，一眼能对上小地图颜色）
function ChoukaPanelPlayerIcon(seat)
    return ChoukaPanelColorIcon(seat)
end

-- ============================================================
-- 底层 UI：自定义文字 / 自定义按钮（照搬官渡的 BangUi* 写法）
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaPanelEnsureText(playerName, index, text, x, y, size)
    if type(exCreateCustomTextForPlayer) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end
    exCreateCustomTextForPlayer(playerName, {
        Index      = index,
        Content    = text or "",
        X          = x,
        Y          = y,
        Color      = CHOUKA_PANEL_COLOR_WHITE,
        Size       = size,
        AlignX     = "left",
        AlignY     = "top",
        GroupIndex = CHOUKA_PANEL_GROUP,
    })
    return 1
end

-- 每个玩家只建一次：标题/提示 + 6 个玩家名 + 7 个操作名，全部先隐藏。
-- 坐标是**每格固定的**（与当前显示哪一页无关），所以建一次就够，之后只改文字和可见性。
function ChoukaPanelEnsureTexts(playerName)
    if ChoukaPanelTexts[playerName] == 1 then
        return 1
    end
    ChoukaPanelEnsureText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_TITLE, "",
        CHOUKA_PANEL_X_TITLE, CHOUKA_PANEL_Y_TITLE, CHOUKA_PANEL_TITLE_SIZE)
    ChoukaPanelEnsureText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_HINT, "",
        CHOUKA_PANEL_X_HINT, CHOUKA_PANEL_Y_HINT, CHOUKA_PANEL_HINT_SIZE)
    local i, col, row
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        col = mod(i - 1, 6)
        row = floor((i - 1) / 6)
        ChoukaPanelEnsureText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_PLAYER + i, CHOUKA_PANEL_PAD,
            CHOUKA_PANEL_P_X + col * CHOUKA_PANEL_P_COL_STEP + CHOUKA_PANEL_PL_DX,
            CHOUKA_PANEL_P_Y + row * CHOUKA_PANEL_P_ROW_STEP + CHOUKA_PANEL_PL_DY,
            CHOUKA_PANEL_LABEL_SIZE)
    end

    ChoukaPanelTexts[playerName] = 1
    return 1
end

function ChoukaPanelSetText(playerName, index, text)
    if type(exCustomTextUpdateTextForPlayer) == "function" then
        exCustomTextUpdateTextForPlayer(playerName, index, text or "")
    end
end

function ChoukaPanelSetTextVisible(playerName, index, visible)
    if type(exCustomTextUpdateVisibilityForPlayer) == "function" then
        exCustomTextUpdateVisibilityForPlayer(playerName, index, visible)
    end
end

-- 只删"这个玩家的"这一格。刻意不退化到全局 exCustomBtnRemove(index)：
-- 那会连带删掉别的玩家同 index 的按钮（官渡那个兜底是个坑）。
function ChoukaPanelRemoveButton(playerName, index)
    if type(exCustomBtnRemoveForPlayer) == "function" then
        exCustomBtnRemoveForPlayer(playerName, index)
    end
end

-- 尺寸显式给（宽高分开）：官渡靠打包贴图自带的 104×104，我们统一成设计值，排版才可预测
function ChoukaPanelCreateButton(playerName, index, texture, desc, x, y, sx, sy)
    if texture == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if type(exCreateCustomButtonForPlayer) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end
    ChoukaPanelRemoveButton(playerName, index)
    exCreateCustomButtonForPlayer(playerName, {
        Index       = index,
        TextureName = texture,
        Desc        = desc or "",
        X           = x,
        Y           = y,
        SizeX       = sx,
        SizeY       = sy,
        GroupIndex  = CHOUKA_PANEL_GROUP,
        AlignX      = "left",
        AlignY      = "top",
    })
    return 1
end

-- 把一页上所有动态按钮/文字清掉
function ChoukaPanelClear(playerName)
    ChoukaPanelRemoveButton(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_I_CLOSE)
    if ChoukaPanelTexts[playerName] ~= 1 then
        return
    end
    local i
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        ChoukaPanelRemoveButton(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_I_PLAYER + i)
        ChoukaPanelSetText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_PLAYER + i, "")
        ChoukaPanelSetTextVisible(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_PLAYER + i, 0)
    end

    ChoukaPanelSetText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_TITLE, "")
    ChoukaPanelSetText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_HINT, "")
    ChoukaPanelSetTextVisible(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_TITLE, 0)
    ChoukaPanelSetTextVisible(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_HINT, 0)
end

-- ============================================================
-- 一页（列表上点了就直接结盟，不再有第二页）
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaPanelShowList(seat)
    local playerName = ChoukaPanelName(seat)
    local seats = ChoukaPanelCollectSeats()
    if getn(seats) == 0 then
        return 0
    end
    ChoukaPanelSlots[playerName] = seats
    ChoukaPanelEnsureTexts(playerName)
    ChoukaPanelClear(playerName)

    local title = ChoukaT.panelTitleMelee
    if CHOUKA_MODE == 1 then
        title = ChoukaT.panelTitleBang
    end
    ChoukaPanelSetText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_TITLE, title)
    ChoukaPanelSetTextVisible(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_TITLE, 1)
    ChoukaPanelSetText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_HINT, ChoukaT.panelHintList)
    ChoukaPanelSetTextVisible(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_HINT, 1)
    ChoukaPanelCreateButton(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_I_CLOSE, ChoukaPanelIconClose(),
        "", CHOUKA_PANEL_X_CLOSE, CHOUKA_PANEL_Y_CLOSE, CHOUKA_PANEL_BTN_W, CHOUKA_PANEL_BTN_H)

    local i, slot, targetSeat, col, row, x, y
    for i = 1, getn(seats), 1 do
        slot = i
        targetSeat = seats[i]
        col = mod(i - 1, 6)
        row = floor((i - 1) / 6)
        x = CHOUKA_PANEL_P_X + col * CHOUKA_PANEL_P_COL_STEP
        y = CHOUKA_PANEL_P_Y + row * CHOUKA_PANEL_P_ROW_STEP
        ChoukaPanelSetText(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_PLAYER + slot,
            ChoukaPanelPlayerLabel(seat, targetSeat))
        ChoukaPanelSetTextVisible(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_T_PLAYER + slot, 1)
        ChoukaPanelCreateButton(playerName, CHOUKA_PANEL_I_PLAYER + slot,
            ChoukaPanelPlayerIcon(targetSeat), "", x, y, CHOUKA_PANEL_P_SIZE, CHOUKA_PANEL_P_SIZE)
    end

    ChoukaPanelState[playerName] = "open"
    return 1
end


function ChoukaPanelHide(seat)
    local playerName = ChoukaPanelName(seat)
    ChoukaPanelClear(playerName)
    ChoukaPanelState[playerName] = "closed"
    return 1
end

function ChoukaPanelToggle(seat)
    local playerName = ChoukaPanelName(seat)
    local state = ChoukaPanelState[playerName]
    if state == nil or state == "closed" then
        return ChoukaPanelShowList(seat)
    end
    return ChoukaPanelHide(seat)
end

-- ============================================================
-- 结盟核心（照搬官渡 setAlliance / isAllied / removeAlliance / BangToggleAlliance）
--   单向记录 + PLAYER_RELATES_PLAYER：结盟设 Neutral（不主动打），解除设 Enemy
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaPanelTell(playerName, text)
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer(playerName, text, 8)
    end
    _LOG("结盟面板：" .. text .. "  -> " .. (playerName or "?"))
end

function ChoukaPanelRelate(fromSeat, toSeat, rel)
    if type(ExecuteAction) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end
    -- 官渡用 SetWorldBuilderThisPlayer 包一层，改关系才生效
    local previous
    if type(SetWorldBuilderThisPlayer) == "function" then
        previous = SetWorldBuilderThisPlayer(1)
    end
    ExecuteAction("PLAYER_RELATES_PLAYER", ChoukaPanelName(fromSeat), ChoukaPanelName(toSeat), rel)
    if previous ~= nil and type(SetWorldBuilderThisPlayer) == "function" then
        SetWorldBuilderThisPlayer(previous)
    end
    return 1
end

function ChoukaPanelIsAllied(fromSeat, toSeat)
    local fromName = ChoukaPanelName(fromSeat)
    if ChoukaAllyFrom[fromName] == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if ChoukaAllyFrom[fromName][ChoukaPanelName(toSeat)] == 1 then
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

-- 三国杀：只有同阵营能结盟（主公/忠臣算同一阵营）
function ChoukaPanelCanAlly(fromSeat, toSeat)
    if CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 then
        return 1
    end
    if type(ChoukaBangRole) ~= "table" then
        return 1
    end
    local roleA = ChoukaBangRole[fromSeat]
    local roleB = ChoukaBangRole[toSeat]
    if roleA == nil or roleB == nil then
        return 1
    end
    if roleA == roleB then
        return 1
    end
    if type(ChoukaBangIsLordSide) == "function" then
        if ChoukaBangIsLordSide(roleA) and ChoukaBangIsLordSide(roleB) then
            return 1
        end
    end
    return 0
end

function ChoukaPanelAllyToggle(fromSeat, toSeat)
    local fromName = ChoukaPanelName(fromSeat)
    local toName = ChoukaPanelName(toSeat)

    if ChoukaPanelIsAllied(fromSeat, toSeat) == 1 then
        -- 解除
        ChoukaAllyFrom[fromName][toName] = nil
        ChoukaPanelRelate(fromSeat, toSeat, "Enemy")
        if ChoukaPanelIsAllied(toSeat, fromSeat) == 1 then
            ChoukaAllyFrom[toName][fromName] = nil
            ChoukaPanelRelate(toSeat, fromSeat, "Enemy")
            ChoukaAlertFor(format(ChoukaT.panelBcBreakBoth,
                ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(fromSeat), ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(toSeat)), 10)
        else
            ChoukaAlertFor(format(ChoukaT.panelBcBreak,
                ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(fromSeat), ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(toSeat)), 10)
        end
        return 1
    end

    if ChoukaPanelCanAlly(fromSeat, toSeat) ~= 1 then
        ChoukaPanelTell(fromName, ChoukaT.panelAllyDenied)
        return 0
    end

    if ChoukaAllyFrom[fromName] == nil then
        ChoukaAllyFrom[fromName] = {}
    end
    ChoukaAllyFrom[fromName][toName] = 1
    ChoukaPanelRelate(fromSeat, toSeat, "Neutral")
    if ChoukaPanelIsAllied(toSeat, fromSeat) == 1 then
        ChoukaAlertFor(format(ChoukaT.panelBcAllyBoth,
            ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(fromSeat), ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(toSeat)), 10)
    else
        ChoukaAlertFor(format(ChoukaT.panelBcAllyOne,
            ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(fromSeat), ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(toSeat)), 10)
    end
    return 1
end


-- ============================================================
-- 点击入口（由 16_buttons.lua 在 onCenterTopBtnClickEvent 里调用）
-- ============================================================

function ChoukaPanelOnBtn(playerName, btnIndex)
    if playerName == nil or btnIndex == nil then
        return 0
    end
    local seat = ChoukaPanelSeatOf(playerName)
    if seat == nil then
        return 0
    end

    if btnIndex == CHOUKA_PANEL_BTN_OPEN then
        -- 三国杀模式下这个按钮由 32_bang_pref.lua 的 ChoukaBangOnBtn 先认领（它还负责私发身份）;
        -- 只有"身份还没发下去"的时候才会落到这里，那时面板没意义，直接不管。
        if CHOUKA_MODE == 1 and ChoukaBangRolesReady ~= 1 then
            return 0
        end
        ChoukaPanelToggle(seat)
        return 1
    end
    if btnIndex == CHOUKA_PANEL_I_CLOSE then
        ChoukaPanelHide(seat)
        return 1
    end
    if btnIndex > CHOUKA_PANEL_I_PLAYER and btnIndex <= CHOUKA_PANEL_I_PLAYER + 6 then
        ChoukaPanelClickPlayer(seat, btnIndex - CHOUKA_PANEL_I_PLAYER)
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

-- 点玩家色块：**一步到位直接结盟 / 解除**（原来要点开操作页再选，作者要求去掉操作页）。
-- 点完立刻重画一遍列表，状态词马上变成最新关系。
function ChoukaPanelClickPlayer(seat, slot)
    local playerName = ChoukaPanelName(seat)
    local seats = ChoukaPanelSlots[playerName]
    if seats == nil then
        return 0
    end
    local targetSeat = seats[slot]
    if targetSeat == nil then
        return 0
    end
    if targetSeat == seat then
        ChoukaPanelTell(playerName, ChoukaT.panelSelf)
        return 0
    end
    if ChoukaPanelSeatAlive(targetSeat) ~= 1 then
        return 0
    end
    ChoukaPanelAllyToggle(seat, targetSeat)
    ChoukaPanelShowList(seat)
    return 1
end

-- 每次求值
-- ============================================================

-- 顶部第 5 个按钮是**唯一的入口**（一个按钮开面板，选完人再展开结盟，和官渡一致）。
--   · 三国杀模式：这个按钮由 30_bang_mode.lua 负责显示（间谍图标 + 身份速览 desc），
--     这里不再插手，只负责接点击（见 32_bang_pref.lua 的 ChoukaBangOnBtn）。
--   · 常规混战：没有身份可言，所以由这里把同一个按钮换成通用结盟图标 + 结盟说明。
if CHOUKA_GAME_STARTED == 1 and CHOUKA_MODE ~= 1 then
    if ChoukaPanelBtnTick < CHOUKA_PANEL_BTN_TICK_MAX then
        ChoukaPanelBtnTick = ChoukaPanelBtnTick + 1
        if type(exCenterTopBtnShowForPlayer) == "function" then
            local i, name
            for i = 1, 6, 1 do
                name = "Player_" .. i
                exCenterTopBtnShowForPlayer(name, CHOUKA_PANEL_BTN_OPEN,
                    ChoukaPanelIconOpen(), ChoukaT.panelBtnDescMelee)
                if type(exCenterTopBtnSetEnableForPlayer) == "function" then
                    exCenterTopBtnSetEnableForPlayer(name, CHOUKA_PANEL_BTN_OPEN, 1)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 结算后把面板收掉
if CHOUKA_BANG_ENDED == 1 and CHOUKA_MODE == 1 then
    if ChoukaPanelEndedCleared ~= 1 then
        ChoukaPanelEndedCleared = 1
        local i
        for i = 1, 6, 1 do
            ChoukaPanelHide(i)
        end
    end
end

--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)

    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then

#!ra3luabridge
-- ============================================================

if _LOG == nil then
    function _LOG(msg)
        if type(exPrintln) == "function" then
            exPrintln("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
        end
    end
end

if _ALERT == nil then
    function _ALERT(msg)
        _LOG(msg)
        if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
            exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
        end
        if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
            exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
        end
    end
end

-- ★ 我方播报用独占名字，绝不抢通用全局名（全局 _ALERT 已被本图别的脚本占用且是哑的）
--   完整来龙去脉见 docs/03 §8「不要去抢通用全局名」；新代码一律用 ChoukaAlert / ChoukaAlertFor。

function ChoukaAlert(msg)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    -- ① 日志（唯一确认可靠的通道，必须第一个调）
    _LOG(msg)
    -- ② 左下消息区
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    -- ③ 公屏（全场可见，阵亡通报/占领播报靠它）
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, 10)
    end
end

-- 带显示时长的版本（公告类用长一点）
function ChoukaAlertFor(msg, seconds)
    if msg == nil then
        return
    end
    _LOG(msg)
    if type(exMessageAppendToMessageArea) == "function" then
        exMessageAppendToMessageArea("[抽卡hex] " .. msg)
    end
    if type(exAddTextToPublicBoard) == "function" then
        if seconds == nil then
            seconds = 10
        end
        exAddTextToPublicBoard(msg, seconds)
    end
end

-- 真实昵称缓存：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 查到的玩家名（查一次就记住）
ChoukaPlayerNames = ChoukaPlayerNames or {}

-- ① 公屏 / 计分板 / 消息区用：真实昵称；拿不到就退回 $p<N>Name（这些通道会替换）
function ChoukaPlayerDisplayName(seat)
    local name = ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if name ~= nil then
        return name
    end
    if seat == nil then
        return "?"
    end
    return format("$p%dName", seat)
end

-- ② 顶部按钮悬浮框 / 对话框 desc 用：这些通道**不替换** $p<N>Name（实测原样显示 $p6Name），
--    所以必须拿到真实字符串；拿不到返回 nil，让调用方兜底成"6 号位"。详见 docs/03 §8.1。
--    注意：exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName 在参考脚本里已被官方删除（38_code.txt:108
--    "该功能已被删除"），所以这里要容忍"接口不存在"和"返回占位符"两种结果。
function ChoukaPlayerPlainName(seat)
    if seat == nil then
        return nil
    end
    local cached = ChoukaPlayerNames[seat]
    if cached ~= nil then
        if cached == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        return cached
    end
    local name = nil
    if type(exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName) == "function" then
        name = exGetPlayerNickNameByScriptName("Player_" .. seat)
    end
    if name == nil or name == "" or strsub(name, 1, 2) == "$p" then
        ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = 0
        _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " 没有可用的真实昵称，悬浮框改用座位号")
        return nil
    end
    ChoukaPlayerNames[seat] = name
    _LOG("玩家名字：Player_" .. seat .. " = " .. name)
    return name
end


-- 节点自检表：哪个节点的 payload 真的跑起来过（只记一次）
ChoukaNodeReady = ChoukaNodeReady or {}

function ChoukaMarkNodeReady(nodeName)
    if ChoukaNodeReady[nodeName] == nil then
        ChoukaNodeReady[nodeName] = 1
        _LOG("节点就绪：" .. nodeName)
    end
end

-- 已经就绪的节点名，拼成一行字符串（给心跳日志用）
function ChoukaNodeReadyList()
    local list = ""
    for name, flag in ChoukaNodeReady do
        if list == "" then
            list = name
        else
            list = list .. "," .. name
        end
    end
    if list == "" then
        return "无"
    end
    return list
end

    ChoukaUiBtnUndo = exPackedTextureImageCreate({
        Texture = textureId,
        CoordsX = 1, CoordsY = 1,
        DimensionsX = 76, DimensionsY = 46,
        TextureDimensionsX = 76, TextureDimensionsY = 46,
        Rotated = 0
    })
end
